title: One for All, All for One: Coordinated Multi-Agent Diffusion Steering via Stochastic Optimal Control

paragraphs.en: Deep generative models often produce structured outputs composed of interacting components. Modelling these outputs with a single model requires learning both the component distributions and their interactions. We pursue a modular alternative: reuse independently trained component generators and learn only how to coordinate them to produce coherent structured outputs. Our framework, C oordinated M ulti-Agent D iffusion S teering ( CMDS ), treats frozen pretrained diffusion models as reusable generative primitives and coordinates their reverse processes through a learned control . We formulate coordination as a stochastic optimal control problem, balancing an assembly-level reward that specifies the desired properties of the combined output against deviations from the pretrained dynamics. The learned control amortises this optimisation, allowing reuse across new task instances. Experiments show that CMDS can recover a known target distribution, satisfy different spatial constraints with the same trained control, and recover individual sources from degraded mixtures. Across multi-agent maze navigation, articulated robot planning, and text-conditioned human motion, CMDS turns frozen models into coordinated multi-agent generators.
paragraphs.zh: 深度生成模型通常会生成由相互作用的组件构成的结构化输出。 使用单一模型对这些输出进行建模，需要同时学习组件的分布及其相互作用。 我们提出一种模块化的替代方案：复用独立训练的组件生成器，并仅学习如何协调它们以生成连贯的结构化输出。 我们的框架——协调多智能体扩散引导（CMDS），将冻结的预训练扩散模型视为可复用的生成基础单元，并通过一个学习得到的控制器来协调它们的反向过程。 我们将协调问题表述为一个随机最优控制问题，在指定组合输出所需特性的组装级奖励与偏离预训练动态之间取得平衡。 学习得到的控制器能够摊销这一优化过程，从而实现在新任务实例中的复用。 实验表明，CMDS 能够恢复已知的目标分布，使用相同的训练控制器满足不同的空间约束，并从退化的混合数据中恢复单个来源。 在多智能体迷宫导航、关节机器人规划以及文本条件化的人类动作生成等任务中，CMDS 将冻结模型转化为协调一致的多智能体生成器。

paragraphs.en: Producing coherent structured outputs involves two distinct problems: modelling individual components and coordinating them when they are used together. End-to-end generative models absorb both into a single generative distribution. We instead build on a long-standing tradition of modular and compositional generative modelling ( Grenander, 1978 ; Bienenstock et al., 1996 ; Williams, 2025 ; Du and Kaelbling, 2024 ) . Component generators, pretrained without joint-system supervision, capture component-level variability, while coordination is learned separately at the level of the structured output. Diffusion models ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021 ; Lai et al., 2025 ) are well suited to this decomposition, as each pretrained reverse process provides a reusable component generative prior whose dynamics can be steered via a learned control while the underlying model remains fixed. Prior work on compositional diffusion generation typically resolves the required coordination at sampling time for each generated instance ( Liu et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Cao et al., 2025 ) . This is sensible for one-off tasks, but becomes costly when related coordination problems recur across many instances. In settings where related coordination problems recur across many instances–for example, across relational design specifications, source-separation observations, or multi-agent start-goal configurations–the associated computation can instead be amortised into a reusable control. Building on recent work showing how controls or amortised samplers can steer pretrained diffusion processes towards task-specific target distributions ( Domingo-Enrich et al., 2024 ; Domingo-Enrich et al., 2025 ; Venkatraman et al., 2024 ) , we thus ask:
paragraphs.zh: 生成连贯的结构化输出涉及两个不同的问题：对单个组件进行建模，以及在它们被共同使用时实现协调。 端到端生成模型将这两个问题整合进单一的生成分布中。 我们则基于一种长期存在的模块化与组合式生成建模传统（Grenander, 1978；Bienenstock 等, 1996；Williams, 2025；Du 和 Kaelbling, 2024）展开研究。 组件生成器在未接受联合系统监督的情况下进行预训练，能够捕捉组件层面的变异性，而协调机制则作为结构化输出层面的独立部分进行学习。 扩散模型（Ho 等, 2020；Song 等, 2021；Lai 等, 2025）非常适合这种分解方法，因为每个预训练的逆过程都提供了一个可重用的组件生成先验，其动态特性可以通过一个学习到的控制器进行引导，而底层模型本身则保持固定。 以往关于组合式扩散生成的研究通常在每个生成的实例中，于采样阶段解决所需的协调问题（Liu 等, 2022；Yang 等, 2023；Cao 等, 2025）。 对于一次性任务而言，这种做法是合理的，但当类似的协调问题在多个实例中重复出现时，其成本会变得很高。 在相关协调问题于多个实例中反复出现的场景下——例如，在关系设计规范、源分离观测或多智能体起点-目标配置中——相关的计算可以转而被摊销为一个可重用的控制器。 基于近期研究表明控制器或摊销采样器如何将预训练的扩散过程引导至任务特定的目标分布（Domingo-Enrich 等, 2024；Domingo-Enrich 等, 2025；Venkatraman 等, 2024），我们因此提出以下问题：

paragraphs.en: The proposed framework begins with independently trained component generators, whose distributions form a reference product distribution over component configurations. An assembly map combines their outputs into a candidate, while an assembly-level reward evaluates the candidate. A learned control then coordinates the component generators towards high-reward joint outputs. To make this concrete, consider planning the movements of several agents through a shared environment. Each frozen copy of a single-agent trajectory model generates a path through the environment, using an agent-specific start and end as conditioning inputs. Stacking these paths produces a candidate multi-agent plan. Although each path may avoid walls in isolation, the assembled plan may still be invalid if agents collide. This illustrates the role of the assembly-level reward. It expresses requirements not captured by the independently trained component models and provides the signal used to coordinate their generation. Generally, the framework requires no training examples of valid structured outputs , only (i) component-level data or pretrained component generators; (ii) an assembly map; and (iii) an assembly-level reward.
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的框架首先使用独立训练的组件生成器，其分布构成组件配置上的参考乘积分布。 一个组装映射将它们的输出组合成一个候选方案，而一个组装级奖励则对候选方案进行评估。 随后，一个学习到的控制器会协调各组件生成器，以产生高奖励的联合输出。 为具体说明这一点，可以考虑规划多个智能体在共享环境中的移动路径。 每个单智能体轨迹模型的固定副本都会生成一条穿过环境的路径，并使用特定于该智能体的起点和终点作为条件输入。 将这些路径叠加起来，即可形成一个候选的多智能体计划。 尽管每条路径单独来看可能不会撞墙，但如果智能体之间发生碰撞，组合后的计划仍然可能无效。 这说明了组装级奖励的作用。 它表达了独立训练的组件模型未能涵盖的需求，并提供了用于协调其生成的信号。 通常，该框架不需要有效结构化输出的训练样本，仅需（i）组件级数据或预训练的组件生成器；（ii）一个组装映射；以及（iii）一个组装级奖励。

paragraphs.en: Coordination as modular post-training. We formulate compositional generation as stochastic optimal control over the joint reverse dynamics of frozen pretrained component diffusion models. The independent component processes define a reference product law, while an assembly-level reward can induce cross-component dependencies, realised by a learned control that couples their reverse dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: 作为模块化后训练的协调。 我们将组合生成表述为对冻结预训练组件扩散模型联合反向动力学的随机最优控制。 独立的组件过程定义了一个参考乘积定律，而组装层级的奖励可以引发跨组件的依赖关系，这种依赖通过一种学习到的控制得以实现，该控制将它们的反向动力学耦合在一起。

sents.en: Coordination as modular post-training.
sents.zh: 作为模块化后训练的协调。

sents.en: We formulate compositional generation as stochastic optimal control over the joint reverse dynamics of frozen pretrained component diffusion models.
sents.zh: 我们将组合生成表述为对冻结预训练组件扩散模型联合反向动力学的随机最优控制。

sents.en: The independent component processes define a reference product law, while an assembly-level reward can induce cross-component dependencies, realised by a learned control that couples their reverse dynamics.
sents.zh: 独立的组件过程定义了一个参考乘积定律，而组装层级的奖励可以引发跨组件的依赖关系，这种依赖通过一种学习到的控制得以实现，该控制将它们的反向动力学耦合在一起。

paragraphs.en: Comprehensive empirical validation. We demonstrate target-law recovery, amortised relational assembly, and source separation. In PointMaze, CMDS coordinates up to four agents and generalises to unseen start–goal regions. Using off-the-shelf KUKA and MDM checkpoints, it turns frozen single-agent models into coordinated multi-agent generators without joint training data. The learned KUKA control transfers to new geometries and additional arms without retraining. In four-person motion generation, CMDS achieves 90% joint success versus 75% for PCD++, with over 250 × 250\times faster sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 全面的经验验证。 我们展示了目标定律恢复、摊销关系组装和源分离。 在 PointMaze 中，CMDS 可协调多达四个智能体，并能推广到未见的起点–终点区域。 使用现成的 KUKA 和 MDM 检查点，它无需联合训练数据即可将冻结的单智能体模型转变为协同的多智能体生成器。 学习到的 KUKA 控制可迁移到新几何结构和额外机械臂上，而无需重新训练。 在四人动作生成中，CMDS 的关节成功率达到 90%，而 PCD++ 仅为 75%，且采样速度超过 250 × 250\times。

paragraphs.en: Importantly, CMDS is non-autoregressive across components. All N N reverse processes evolve concurrently along the same generative-time axis, and at each time s s , the control u s i ​ ( X ^ s ) u_{s}^{i}(\hat{X}_{s}) applied to agent i i may depend on the current state of every agent. No component is therefore generated and fixed before the others. This avoids imposing an arbitrary ordering over components and enables corrections throughout generation, which is particularly important when the assembly-level criterion depends on their joint configuration. The component updates may also be evaluated in parallel, subject to the cost of the coordination modules.
paragraphs.zh: 重要的是，CMDS 在各个组件之间是非自回归的。 所有 N 个反向过程都沿着相同的生成时间轴并行演化，在每个时刻 s，施加于智能体 i 的控制 u_{s}^{i}(\hat{X}_{s}) 可能依赖于每个智能体的当前状态。 因此，没有任何一个组件会在其他组件之前被生成并固定下来。 这避免了对组件施加任意的顺序，并允许在整个生成过程中进行修正，当装配层级的标准取决于它们的联合配置时，这一点尤为重要。 组件的更新也可以并行评估，但需考虑协调模块所带来的成本。

paragraphs.en: CMDS is defined by jointly controlling the reference product process under the SOC objective in eq. 3 , whereas AM is one possible strategy for learning the coordination control U θ U_{\theta} , rather than part of the framework. When the reverse solver and assembly-level reward are differentiable, U θ U_{\theta} may instead be learned by directly optimising the discretised SOC objective; we refer to reverse-mode differentiation through the solver transitions as discrete-adjoint optimisation ( Domingo-Enrich, 2024 ) . Alternatively, path-space objectives such as relative trajectory balance ( Venkatraman et al., 2024 ) could be adapted to the joint controlled reverse process to target the same reward-tilted law, provided that the corresponding controlled-to-reference trajectory-density ratio is tractable. We adopt AM since it propagates gradient information without backpropagating through the complete computational graph of the sampling rollout.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate CMDS along three axes: (i) a tractable stochastic-control problem with a known optimal solution, to assess recovery of the target distribution rather than constraint satisfaction alone; (ii) source separation, to assess posterior inference from blurred mixtures when paired source–mixture training data are unavailable; and (iii) multi-agent motion, to assess scalability to larger models and more agents using off-the-shelf pretrained checkpoints, including zero-shot transfer to changed geometry and additional agents without retraining the control. Additionally, we study constraint satisfaction and amortised coordination across relational specifications in Section D.2 . These constrained visual-assembly experiments provide a controlled test-bed to isolate the effects of component factorisation, reward design, amortisation, and optimisation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从三个维度评估 CMDS：(i) 一个具有已知最优解的可处理随机控制问题，用于评估目标分布的恢复能力，而不仅仅是约束满足；(ii) 源分离，用于在缺乏成对的源-混合训练数据时，评估从模糊混合信号中进行后验推断的能力；以及 (iii) 多智能体运动，用于评估使用现成的预训练检查点向更大模型和更多智能体的扩展能力，包括无需重新训练控制策略即可实现零样本迁移以适应几何变化和新增智能体的情况。 此外，我们在 D.2 节中研究了跨关系性规范下的约束满足与摊销协调问题。 这些受约束的视觉装配实验提供了一个受控的测试平台，用于分离组件因子分解、奖励设计、摊销和优化所带来的影响。

paragraphs.en: We consider posterior inference in which N N frozen pretrained diffusion samplers independently define component priors through their reverse processes, with reference terminal samples X ^ 1 i ∼ π ~ i \hat{X}_{1}^{i}\sim\tilde{\pi}^{i} . Let X = ( X 1 , … , X N ) X=(X^{1},\ldots,X^{N}) denote the unknown component state, whose non-injective additive assembly is Y = φ ⁡ ( X ) := ∑ i = 1 N X i Y=\varphi(X):=\sum_{i=1}^{N}X^{i} , and suppose that we observe a blurred mixture b = A τ ​ ( Y ) + ε b={\rm{A}}_{\tau}(Y)+\varepsilon , where A τ {\rm{A}}_{\tau} is a known Gaussian blurring operator with standard deviation τ \tau , and ε ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , σ ε 2 ​ I ) \varepsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_{\varepsilon}^{2}I) . Since the additive assembly φ \varphi is non-injective, the observation does not uniquely identify its constituent sources; the independently pretrained component priors therefore regularise the resulting compositional posterior over valid decompositions. Assuming Gaussian observation noise, we define the assembly-level reward r b ​ ( y ) := − 1 2 ​ σ ε 2 ​ ‖ A τ ​ ( y ) − b ‖ 2 r_{b}(y):=-\frac{1}{2\sigma_{\varepsilon}^{2}}\|{\rm{A}}_{\tau}(y)-b\|^{2} . The pretrained diffusion models define the reference product law ρ = π ~ 1 ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ π ~ N \rho=\tilde{\pi}^{1}\otimes\cdots\otimes\tilde{\pi}^{N} , while CMDS performs compositional posterior inference by coordinating their reverse dynamics, producing controlled terminal components X ^ 1 θ = ( X ^ 1 θ , 1 , … , X ^ 1 θ , N ) \hat{X}_{1}^{\theta}=(\hat{X}_{1}^{\theta,1},\ldots,\hat{X}_{1}^{\theta,N}) whose assembly Y ^ 1 θ = φ ⁡ ( X ^ 1 θ ) \hat{Y}_{1}^{\theta}=\varphi(\hat{X}_{1}^{\theta}) jointly explains the observation b b , without requiring training samples from the joint source distribution. For comparison, we adapt diffusion posterior sampling (DPS) ( Chung et al., 2023 ) to the product prior, paralleling the posterior-sampling construction of Luan et al. (2025) . At each reverse step, we evaluate the observation likelihood on the Tweedie estimates ( Efron, 2011 ) of both processes and apply the resulting component-wise gradients to their reverse updates; details are given in Section D.3 .

paragraphs.en: As shown in fig. 4 , CMDS achieves the strongest overall recovery under the challenging τ = 1 \tau=1 blur. It yields the lowest clean-mixture reconstruction error and the highest source intersection over union (IoU), while maintaining the low shape distortion induced by the frozen component priors. DPS substantially improves source localisation over independent reference sampling, but markedly distorts the components and yields a larger reconstruction error than CMDS . This localisation–distortion trade-off reflects the non-identifiability of the problem. The likelihood depends only on the assembled mixture X 1 + X 2 X^{1}+X^{2} , through A τ ​ ( X 1 + X 2 ) {\rm A}_{\tau}(X^{1}+X^{2}) , and therefore contains no direct information about the differential mode X 1 − X 2 X^{1}-X^{2} that distinguishes the individual sources. Consequently, the step-wise likelihood corrections used by DPS can improve the reward by redistributing or deforming mass in ways that are poorly aligned with the pretrained component distributions. By contrast, rather than applying step-wise likelihood guidance, CMDS learns joint feedback over the product of the pretrained reverse processes, while the quadratic path-action penalty favours small coordinated deviations from the frozen dynamics, helping preserve component structure. Quantitative results under milder blur are provided in Section D.3 .

paragraphs.en: We investigate multi-agent navigation problems where agents move through a shared environment, between prescribed start- and end-points, while satisfying task-specific constraints and avoiding collisions. We consider planar navigation (PointMaze) ( Fu et al., 2020 ) , articulated robot planning (KUKA) ( Luo et al., 2024 ) , and text-conditioned human motion (MDM) ( Tevet et al., 2023 ) . Pretrained single-agent priors generate component trajectories, the assembly operator combines them, and an assembly-level reward coordinates their movement. Throughout, the component priors remain frozen and only the coordination control is learned. PointMaze and KUKA condition the component models on prescribed start and end points. For MDM, component models are text-conditioned and end points are supplied to the coordination control. Success requires every agent to satisfy the task-specific goal, avoid collisions, and pass task-specific feasibility checks. Further details are in Sections D.4 , D.5 and D.6 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了多智能体导航问题，其中智能体在共享环境中移动，往返于指定的起点和终点之间，同时满足任务特定的约束并避免碰撞。 我们考虑了平面导航（PointMaze）（Fu et al., 2020）、可动关节机器人规划（KUKA）（Luo et al., 2024）以及文本条件化的人类运动（MDM）（Tevet et al., 2023）。 预训练的单一智能体先验模型生成组件轨迹，组装操作符将其组合起来，而组装级别的奖励则协调它们的移动。 在整个过程中，组件先验模型保持冻结状态，仅学习协调控制部分。 PointMaze 和 KUKA 将组件模型的条件设定为指定的起点和终点。 对于 MDM，组件模型以文本为条件，而终点则提供给协调控制模块。 成功的关键在于每个智能体都必须满足任务特定的目标、避免碰撞，并通过任务特定的可行性检查。 更多细节见 D.4、D.5 和 D.6 节。

sents.zh: 我们考虑了平面导航（PointMaze）（Fu et al., 2020）、可动关节机器人规划（KUKA）（Luo et al., 2024）以及文本条件化的人类运动（MDM）（Tevet et al., 2023）。

sents.en: Pretrained single-agent priors generate component trajectories, the assembly operator combines them, and an assembly-level reward coordinates their movement.
sents.zh: 预训练的单一智能体先验模型生成组件轨迹，组装操作符将其组合起来，而组装级别的奖励则协调它们的移动。

sents.en: Throughout, the component priors remain frozen and only the coordination control is learned.
sents.zh: 在整个过程中，组件先验模型保持冻结状态，仅学习协调控制部分。

sents.en: PointMaze and KUKA condition the component models on prescribed start and end points.
sents.zh: PointMaze 和 KUKA 将组件模型的条件设定为指定的起点和终点。

sents.en: For MDM, component models are text-conditioned and end points are supplied to the coordination control.
sents.zh: 对于 MDM，组件模型以文本为条件，而终点则提供给协调控制模块。

sents.en: Success requires every agent to satisfy the task-specific goal, avoid collisions, and pass task-specific feasibility checks.
sents.zh: 成功的关键在于每个智能体都必须满足任务特定的目标、避免碰撞，并通过任务特定的可行性检查。

sents.en: Further details are in Sections D.4 , D.5 and D.6 .
sents.zh: 更多细节见 D.4、D.5 和 D.6 节。

paragraphs.en: We pretrain one conditional single-agent trajectory prior for each of the “Medium” and “Large” layouts ( Fu et al., 2020 ) , then coordinate two or four copies. The reward penalises insufficient wall clearance, inter-agent collisions, path length, and trajectory acceleration. We evaluate on two sets of unseen start–end instances. Pool 1 places starts and goals in navigable grid squares used during control training, whereas Pool 2 uses squares excluded from control training ( Section D.4.3 ). Tables 1 and 5 compare independent reference sampling, Best-of-256, FK-Steering ( Singhal et al., 2025 ) , DPS ( Chung et al., 2022 ) , and our learned control. We evaluate two parameterisations of the coordination control: CMDS uses an attention-based control conditioned on the joint multi-agent state, while CMDS +TRG additionally incorporates the Tweedie reward gradient (TRG), namely the reward gradient evaluated at the Tweedie estimate, inspired by prior work ( Denker et al., 2024 ; Venkatraman et al., 2024 ) . CMDS +TRG improves or matches the reported base- CMDS rates, achieving Pool 2 success between 89.8 % 89.8\% and 99.2 % 99.2\% across the reported settings; DPS is the best performing on “Large” with two agents. Across five independent training seeds per setting, CMDS +TRG achieves mean Pool 2 success between 90.6 % 90.6\% and 98.3 % 98.3\% , with training-seed standard deviations no larger than 1.5 1.5 percentage points ( Section D.4.8 ). To stabilise adjoint-matching training against large residuals, we use a pseudo-Huber regression loss in place of the squared loss; details are in Section D.4.7 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们为“Medium”和“Large”布局分别预训练一个条件单智能体轨迹先验（Fu et al., 2020），然后协调两个或四个副本。 奖励函数会对墙体间隙不足、智能体间碰撞、路径长度以及轨迹加速度施加惩罚。 我们在两组未见过的起点–终点实例上进行评估。 Pool 1 将起点和终点置于控制训练期间使用的可导航网格格点中，而 Pool 2 则使用控制训练中排除的格点（Section D.4.3）。 表 1 和表 5 比较了独立参考采样、Best-of-256、FK-Steering（Singhal et al., 2025）、DPS（Chung et al., 2022）以及我们学习的控制方法。 我们评估了协调控制的两种参数化形式：CMDS 使用基于注意力的控制，并以联合多智能体状态为条件；而 CMDS +TRG 还额外引入了 Tweedie 奖励梯度（TRG），即在对 Tweedie 估计值处计算的奖励梯度，这一设计受早期工作启发（Denker et al., 2024; Venkatraman et al., 2024）。 CMDS +TRG 改进或达到了已报告的基线 CMDS 成功率，在已报告的设置中，Pool 2 的成功率介于 89.8% 和 99.2% 之间；在“Large”布局下使用两个智能体时，DPS 表现最佳。 在每个设置的五个独立训练种子中，CMDS +TRG 实现的 Pool 2 平均成功率介于 90.6% 和 98.3% 之间，且训练种子的标准差不超过 1.5 个百分点（Section D.4.8）。 为稳定伴随匹配训练并防止大残差的影响，我们使用伪-Huber 回归损失替代平方损失；相关细节见 Section D.4.7。

paragraphs.en: We coordinate two seven-joint robot arms in a shared environment containing obstacles. Each task specifies the obstacle layout and the start and goal configurations of both arms. A shared CMDS +TRG control coordinates frozen pretrained single-arm diffusion models to generate their paths jointly.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个包含障碍物的共享环境中协调两个七关节机器人手臂。 每个任务都会指定障碍物的布局以及两个手臂的起始和目标构型。 一个共享的 CMDS +TRG 控制器会协调冻结的预训练单臂扩散模型，以联合生成它们的路径。

sents.en: We coordinate two seven-joint robot arms in a shared environment containing obstacles.
sents.zh: 我们在一个包含障碍物的共享环境中协调两个七关节机器人手臂。

paragraphs.en: Publicly released checkpoints ( Luo et al., 2024 ) predict noise as an energy gradient, ϵ ψ = ∇ x E ψ \epsilon_{\psi}=\nabla_{x}E_{\psi} . Adjoint propagation therefore requires Hessian–vector products through the energy, while the checkpoint parameters remain frozen. Strict success requires both arms to reach their goals, remain within the allowed angular range of every robot joint, and pass checks for inter-arm collisions, self-collisions, and collisions with the obstacles and worktable. We evaluate on the test layouts released by Luo et al. (2024) , unseen by both the priors and the controller ( Section D.5.1 ), and denote by n cand n_{\mathrm{cand}} the number of initial candidate multi-arm plans generated per task. With one candidate plan, CMDS +TRG achieves 77.3 % 77.3\% strict success, compared with 11.4 % 11.4\% for the reference independent single-arm sampling and 51.0 % 51.0\% when adding collision guidance (see table 2 ). Using the separately pretrained two-arm diffusion prior, guided Dual KUKA achieves 74.3 % 74.3\% , while Potential Based Diffusion Motion Planning (PBDM; Luo et al., 2024 ) achieves 60.9 % 60.9\% using the same prior within its native candidate-selection and refinement procedure. We also apply the learned control without retraining to shifted or enlarged obstacles, wider arm-base spacing, and additional arms ( table 3 ). On a separate set of tasks with five arms and four candidates per task ( n cand = 4 n_{\mathrm{cand}}=4 ), CMDS + TRG achieves 68.3 % 68.3\% strict success, compared with 48.3 % 48.3\% for guided single-arm priors. Additional information is provided in Section D.5 .

paragraphs.en: We use the 50-step MDM checkpoint ( Tevet et al., 2023 ) to coordinate four independently text-conditioned people over six-second motions (see Section D.6 ). A generated scene is successful when all four people move from their starting positions to their targets, shown in the top-down insets of fig. 7 , and their motions pass both the inter-person collision and kinematic-validity checks. Baselines include Best-of- 256 256 , DPS, PCD ( Luan et al., 2025 ) , and our PCD++ extension, which jointly optimises noisy motions through the frozen denoiser for goal attainment and clearance (see Algorithm 2 ). Tables 4 and 7 report 90 % 90\% joint success for CMDS versus 75 % 75\% for PCD++. PCD++ has a higher collision-free rate, but lower joint success and longer sampling time.

paragraphs.en: We introduced CMDS , a modular post-training framework for coordinating frozen pretrained diffusion models through stochastic optimal control. An assembly-level reward specifies joint requirements, while an amortised control couples the component reverse processes under a quadratic path-action penalty. Experiments demonstrate target-law recovery in a tractable setting, amortised relational assembly, and source recovery, while released KUKA and MDM priors extend coordination to multi-arm planning and multi-person motion. Transfer to additional robot arms further illustrates the reuse enabled by learning coordination separately from component generation. Together, these results show that frozen component models can support structured tasks beyond their individual training settings through learned interactions. Future work includes improving reward design, characterising how robust matching and control parameterisation affect target-law approximation, and extending coordination to larger, more heterogeneous generative models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CMDS，一个模块化后训练框架，通过随机最优控制来协调冻结的预训练扩散模型。 装配级奖励指定了联合要求，而摊销控制则在二次路径-动作惩罚下将各组件的反向过程耦合在一起。 实验表明，在可处理的设定中实现了目标定律恢复、摊销关系装配和源恢复；同时，已发布的 KUKA 和 MDM 先验将协调扩展到了多臂规划和多人运动。 将其迁移到更多机器人手臂上进一步说明，通过独立学习协调与组件生成，可以实现知识的重复利用。 综合来看，这些结果表明，冻结的组件模型可以通过所学到的相互作用，支持超越其个体训练设定的结构化任务。 未来的工作包括改进奖励设计、描述稳健匹配与控制参数化如何影响目标定律近似，以及将协调扩展到更大、更具异构性的生成模型。

paragraphs.en: Modular generative modelling has a long history in pattern theory and structured scene representations ( Grenander, 1978 ; Bienenstock et al., 1996 ; Williams, 2025 ) , and recent work advocates composing specialised generators rather than learning every combination within a single model ( Du and Kaelbling, 2024 ) . For diffusion models, this perspective has motivated compositional visual generation through combinations of conditional scores ( Liu et al., 2022 ) and sampling methods for composed energy-based models ( Du et al., 2023 ) . Related approaches compose learned constraint factors ( Yang et al., 2023 ) or diffusion policies across skills, domains, and input modalities ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Cao et al., 2025 ) . CMDS follows this modular perspective while explicitly distinguishing component states from their assembled output. Each frozen generator supplies a component, and an assembly-level reward specifies the interactions introduced through learned joint control.
paragraphs.zh: 模块化生成式建模在模式理论和结构化场景表示领域拥有悠久的历史（Grenander，1978；Bienenstock 等，1996；Williams，2025），而近期的研究则主张通过组合专门的生成器，而非在单一模型中学习所有可能的组合（Du 和 Kaelbling，2024）。 对于扩散模型而言，这一视角推动了通过条件得分的组合实现组合式视觉生成（Liu 等，2022），以及为组合能量模型设计的采样方法（Du 等，2023）。 相关方法则通过组合已学习的约束因子（Yang 等，2023）或跨技能、领域和输入模态的扩散策略（Wang 等，2024；Cao 等，2025）来实现组合生成。 CMDS 遵循这种模块化视角，同时明确区分组件状态与其组装后的输出结果。 每个冻结的生成器提供一个组件，而组装层面的奖励则用于定义通过联合控制所引入的相互作用。

paragraphs.en: A related line of work coordinates multiple pretrained diffusion processes directly during generation. MultiDiffusion binds multiple denoising paths through shared image-generation constraints ( Bar-Tal et al., 2023 ) , while SyncDiffusion synchronises image patches using perceptual-similarity gradients ( Lee et al., 2023 ) . MMDisCo coordinates frozen single-modal diffusion models using a discriminator trained on paired audio–video examples ( Hayakawa et al., 2025 ) . In contrast to paired-data supervision, CMDS learns coordination from an assembly-level reward under a path-space control objective, without requiring training examples of valid joint outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 一项相关的工作在生成过程中直接协调多个预训练的扩散过程。 MultiDiffusion 通过共享的图像生成约束将多个去噪路径绑定在一起（Bar-Tal 等人，2023），而 SyncDiffusion 则利用感知相似性梯度来同步图像块（Lee 等人，2023）。 MMDisCo 使用一个在成对音频-视频示例上训练的判别器来协调冻结的单模态扩散模型（Hayakawa 等人，2025）。 与成对数据监督不同，CMDS 通过路径空间控制目标从装配级奖励中学习协调机制，而无需有效的联合输出训练示例。

paragraphs.en: Coordinated Diffusion (CoDi; Peters et al., 2026 ) and Projected Coupled Diffusion (PCD; Luan et al., 2025 ) are particularly close to our setting. CoDi constructs a KL-regularised cooperative objective relative to single-agent base policies and guides their diffusion processes simultaneously. Its sampling-based guidance estimator uses online cost evaluations without requiring cost gradients. PCD likewise introduces interactions between pretrained diffusion processes at test time, combining cost-based guidance with projections onto prescribed constraint sets. CMDS shares the use of separately pretrained generators and a joint criterion, but learns a reusable control across task instances under a quadratic path-action penalty. Coordination is therefore amortised into a joint-state control, rather than reconstructed solely through inference-time guidance. The approaches also differ in their constraint treatment: PCD explicitly projects onto supplied constraint sets, whereas the finite reward penalties used in our experiments do not guarantee hard constraint satisfaction. Our current adjoint-based implementation additionally assumes differentiable rewards, unlike CoDi’s cost estimator. Since CoDi and PCD act at inference time, they are complementary to amortised coordination: their guidance or projection mechanisms could in principle be applied on top of a learned CMDS control when additional instance-specific constraints must be imposed at sampling time.
paragraphs.zh: 协同扩散（CoDi；Peters 等，2026）和投影耦合扩散（PCD；Luan 等，2025）与我们设定的场景尤为接近。 CoDi 针对单个智能体的基础策略构建了一个经过 KL 正则化的协作目标，并同步引导其扩散过程。 其基于采样的引导估计器使用在线成本评估，而无需依赖成本梯度。 PCD 同样在测试阶段引入了预训练扩散过程之间的相互作用，将基于成本的引导与向预定约束集的投影相结合。 CMDS 也采用了独立预训练的生成器和联合准则，但它在二次路径-动作惩罚下，学习了一种可在不同任务实例间复用的控制策略。 因此，协同作用被摊销到联合状态控制中，而非仅通过推理阶段的引导重新构建。 这些方法在约束处理上也有所不同：PCD 会显式地投影到给定的约束集上，而我们实验中使用的有限奖励惩罚则无法保证严格满足约束条件。 此外，我们当前基于伴随变量的实现假设了奖励函数可微，这与 CoDi 的成本估计器不同。 由于 CoDi 和 PCD 在推理阶段发挥作用，它们与摊销协同方法互为补充：当采样时需要施加额外的实例特定约束时，原则上可以将它们的引导或投影机制叠加到已学习的 CMDS 控制之上。

paragraphs.en: Diffuser formulates planning as guided generation of trajectories ( Janner et al., 2022 ) . Multi-agent extensions such as MADiff learn coordinated behaviour from offline multi-agent trajectories ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) . Closer to our data assumptions, Multi-robot Multi-model planning Diffusion (MMD) combines single-agent diffusion priors with constraint-based search and replanning ( Shaoul et al., 2025 ) . Our motion experiments similarly begin from frozen component priors, but learn coordination separately from component generation. In PointMaze, we coordinate copies of a single-agent trajectory prior across start–goal instances; in KUKA, we coordinate copies of a released single-arm energy-based prior for multi-arm planning; and in the MDM experiment, we coordinate copies of a released text-conditioned single-person motion diffusion prior to generate collision-aware multi-person motion. Across these settings, the component models are not trained on the corresponding multi-agent task, while coordination is amortised into a reusable joint control rather than resolved solely through instance-specific search or guidance.
paragraphs.zh: Diffuser 将规划表述为受引导的轨迹生成（Janner 等，2022）。 MADiff 等多智能体扩展方法通过离线多智能体轨迹学习协同行为（Zhu 等，2024）。 更贴近我们数据假设的是，多机器人多模型规划扩散（MMD）将单智能体扩散先验与基于约束的搜索和重新规划相结合（Shaoul 等，2025）。 我们的运动实验同样从冻结的组件先验开始，但将协同学习从组件生成中分离出来。 在 PointMaze 中，我们在不同起点–目标实例间协调单智能体轨迹先验的副本；在 KUKA 中，我们为多臂规划协调一个已发布的单臂基于能量的先验的副本；而在 MDM 实验中，我们协调一个已发布的文本条件化的单人运动扩散先验的副本，以生成考虑碰撞的多人体运动。 在这些设置中，组件模型并未在对应的多智能体任务上进行训练，而协同过程则被摊销为可重用的联合控制，而非仅通过实例特定的搜索或引导来解决。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion posterior sampling (DPS) conditions pretrained diffusion models on observations through approximate likelihood guidance evaluated using denoised estimates ( Chung et al., 2023 ) . FK-Steering instead uses reward-dependent particle reweighting and resampling during generation ( Singhal et al., 2025 ) ; its particles represent alternative complete candidates, rather than the components of one assembled output. Our source-separation experiment places the observation model after an additive assembly and performs inference over the constituent sources. We compare against DPS adapted to the same product prior, while learning observation-dependent joint feedback under a path-action penalty. Amortisation is compatible with additional test-time information: our Tweedie reward-gradient parameterisation retains explicit reward-gradient features within the learned control. The test-time coordination mechanisms of PCD ( Luan et al., 2025 ) and CoDi ( Peters et al., 2026 ) are closely related to the cooperative DPS (CDPS) baseline introduced in earlier work ( Barbano et al., 2026 ) . CDPS replaces a learned cooperative control with per-step guidance obtained from a joint cost evaluated on the agents’ Tweedie estimates. PCD explicitly derives an analogous posterior-sampling variant, in which a coupling cost evaluated on Tweedie-denoised component estimates is differentiated through each diffusion process. CoDi follows the same general principle of augmenting the product of single-agent diffusion scores with an online joint cost-guidance term, but estimates this correction gradient-free. These methods therefore provide non-amortised, inference-time alternatives to CMDS , whereas CMDS learns a reusable joint feedback control across task instances.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散后验采样（DPS）通过利用去噪估计值评估的近似似然引导，对预训练的扩散模型进行条件训练（Chung et al., 2023）。 FK-Steering 则在生成过程中使用依赖奖励的粒子重加权与重采样（Singhal et al., 2025）；其粒子代表替代的完整候选方案，而非单个组合输出中的各个组成部分。 我们的源分离实验将观测模型置于加法组合之后，并对构成该组合的各个源进行推理。 我们将 DPS 与适配相同乘积先验的方法进行比较，同时在路径-动作惩罚下学习依赖观测的联合反馈。 摊销机制能够兼容测试时的额外信息：我们的 Tweedie 奖励梯度参数化方法在已学习的控制策略中保留了显式的奖励梯度特征。 PCD（Luan et al., 2025）和 CoDi（Peters et al., 2026）的测试时协调机制，与早期工作（Barbano et al., 2026）中提出的协作 DPS（CDPS）基线密切相关。 CDPS 用一个已学习的协作控制策略替代了每一步的引导，该引导来自在智能体的 Tweedie 估计值上评估的联合成本。 PCD 明确推导出了类似的后验采样变体，其中在 Tweedie 去噪后的组件估计值上评估的耦合成本，会通过每个扩散过程进行求导。 CoDi 遵循相同的总体原则，即将单智能体扩散得分的乘积与在线联合成本引导项相结合，但通过无梯度估计的方式实现这一修正。 因此，这些方法为 CMDS 提供了非摊销的推理时替代方案，而 CMDS 则能在不同任务实例间学习可重用的联合反馈控制。

paragraphs.en: Optimal-control perspectives connect diffusion generation and reward-based fine-tuning to controlled dynamics and relative-entropy regularisation ( Berner et al., 2024 ; Uehara et al., 2024 ) . Stochastic optimal control matching and adjoint matching develop regression-based approaches for learning such controls ( Domingo-Enrich et al., 2024 ; Domingo-Enrich et al., 2025 ) . DEFT learns a generalised h h -transform correction while keeping the pretrained diffusion model frozen ( Denker et al., 2024 ) , and relative trajectory balance amortises posterior sampling through a path-space balance objective ( Venkatraman et al., 2024 ) . Building on these foundations, CMDS coordinates a reference product process through an assembly-level reward and joint-state feedback, with the component generators remaining frozen. Adjoint matching is one learning strategy within this framework; our discrete implementation uses the full controlled-transition adjoint, rather than the lean-adjoint variant of Domingo-Enrich et al. (2025) .
paragraphs.zh: 最优控制视角将扩散生成和基于奖励的微调与受控动态及相对熵正则化联系起来（Berner 等，2024；Uehara 等，2024）。 随机最优控制匹配和伴随匹配为学习此类控制方法发展了基于回归的策略（Domingo-Enrich 等，2024；Domingo-Enrich 等，2025）。 DEFT 在保持预训练扩散模型冻结的同时，学习了一种广义的 h h -变换校正（Denker 等，2024），而相对轨迹平衡则通过路径空间平衡目标来摊销后验采样（Venkatraman 等，2024）。 基于这些基础，CMDS 通过装配级奖励和联合状态反馈协调一个参考产品过程，同时各组件生成器保持冻结。 伴随匹配是该框架内的一种学习策略；我们的离散实现使用了完整的受控转移伴随方法，而非 Domingo-Enrich 等（2025）提出的精简伴随变体。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, a precise interpretation is that the assembly reward performs joint credit assignment across agents at the terminal time, and the lean adjoint dynamics subsequently propagate the information assigned to each agent backward through each agent’s own frozen dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，一种精确的解释是：组装奖励在终端时刻对各个智能体进行联合信用分配，随后，精简伴随动态将分配给每个智能体的信息通过每个智能体自身的冻结动态向后传播。

paragraphs.en: For factorised reference dynamics, the lean-adjoint propagation only needs agent-wise vectors. If the cost of each component model is fixed, the computational cost of this lean-adjoint backward propagation grows linearly with respect to the number of agents, and can be parallelly computed. On the other hand, the full adjoint additionally differentiates through the joint control U θ U_{\theta} , and its block form contains cross-agent terms D x i ​ U θ j D_{x^{i}}U^{j}_{\theta} representing dependencies introduced by the coordination network. The lean adjoint matching removes these interactions from the adjoint propagation through the reference dynamics. Note that this does not imply that the overall CMDS computation is necessarily linear in the number of agents N N , as the evaluation of the assembly reward and joint control could potentially involve higher-order interactions among different agents.
paragraphs.zh: 对于分解后的参考动态，瘦伴随传播仅需每个智能体对应的向量。 如果每个组件模型的成本是固定的，那么这种瘦伴随反向传播的计算成本将随着智能体数量的增加而线性增长，并且可以并行计算。 另一方面，完整伴随方法还会对联合控制 U θ U_{\theta} 进行额外求导，其块形式包含跨智能体项 D x i ​ U θ j D_{x^{i}}U^{j}_{\theta}，这些项表示协调网络引入的依赖关系。 瘦伴随匹配通过参考动态从伴随传播中移除了这些相互作用。 需要注意的是，这并不意味着整体的 CMDS 计算在智能体数量 N N 上一定是线性的，因为组合奖励和联合控制的评估可能涉及不同智能体之间的高阶相互作用。

paragraphs.en: For the reasons discussed above, in this work we retain the full adjoint rather than the lean variant. In particular, the discrete DDIM recursion below differentiates the controlled transition and includes the quadratic control-cost derivative, thereby preserving the full cross-agent dependencies that are not detached by the task-specific implementation. A discrete lean CMDS variant could instead propagate adjoints through the frozen base transitions only, in analogy with the lean DDIM construction of Domingo-Enrich et al. (2025) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于上述讨论的原因，本研究保留了完整的伴随算子，而非精简版本。 具体而言，下文的离散 DDIM 递归对受控转移进行了求导，并包含了二次控制成本导数，从而保留了任务特定实现中未被解耦的智能体间完整依赖关系。 相比之下，一种离散的精简 CMDS 变体可以仅通过冻结的基础转移传播伴随算子，这与 Domingo-Enrich 等人（2025）提出的精简 DDIM 构建方法类似。

paragraphs.en: The two scalar coefficient networks have separate parameters. This equivariant parameterisation is a natural inductive bias because both the reference dynamics and the terminal cost are invariant to a common rotation of the two-agent system. The optimal correction therefore acts along the relative displacement between the agents, pushing them apart when their predicted terminal separation is too small and pulling them together when it is too large. The comparisons in figs. 8 and 9 highlight the importance of this inductive bias. The uncontrolled OU process concentrates both agents near the origin and therefore produces terminal separations substantially below the target. The value-function oracle achieves the prescribed separation while preserving rotational symmetry. The importance-sampling baseline approximates the same terminal tilt but suffers from finite-sample variance. The unconstrained MLP control can substantially reduce the terminal-distance error, but it may select a preferred direction in the plane and thereby collapse the terminal-angle distribution. In contrast, the rotation-equivariant control achieves a terminal separation close to the target while maintaining an approximately uniform angular distribution, substantially closer to the oracle. Thus, terminal-distance accuracy alone is insufficient: a control may satisfy the relational constraint while distorting symmetries and diversity of the target law. This toy problem provides a controlled SOC sanity check in which the component dynamics are known, the global constraint is purely relational, and a reduced value-function oracle is available. The experiment tests whether a learned control can balance satisfaction of a terminal system-level constraint against quadratic path action. It therefore provides a low-dimensional analogue of the least-action principle underlying CMDS : instead of arbitrarily moving samples toward high reward, the control seeks the smallest path-space perturbation required to make independently evolving components satisfy a consistency criterion.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个标量系数网络具有独立的参数。 这种等变参数化是一种自然的归纳偏置，因为参考动态和终端成本都对双智能体系统的共同旋转保持不变。 因此，最优修正沿着智能体之间的相对位移方向进行：当预测的终端间距过小时，将它们推开；当间距过大时，则将它们拉近。 图8和图9中的比较凸显了这种归纳偏置的重要性。 无控制的OU过程使两个智能体都集中在原点附近，因此产生的终端间距远低于目标值。 价值函数神谕在保持旋转对称性的同时实现了规定的间距。 重要性采样基线近似得到了相同的终端倾斜，但存在有限样本方差的问题。 无约束的MLP控制可以显著降低终端距离误差，但它可能会在平面内选择一个偏好方向，从而导致终端角度分布坍缩。 相比之下，旋转等变控制在保持接近目标的终端间距的同时，实现了近似均匀的角度分布，与神谕的结果更接近。 因此，仅靠终端距离的准确性是不够的：一种控制可能满足关系性约束，同时却扭曲了目标分布的对称性和多样性。 这个玩具问题提供了一个受控的SOC合理性检验：其中组件动态已知，全局约束纯粹是关系性的，并且可以使用一个简化的价值函数神谕。 该实验检验了学习到的控制能否在满足终端系统级约束与二次路径动作之间取得平衡。 因此，它提供了CMDS底层最小作用量原理的低维类比：控制并非随意将样本向高奖励区域移动，而是寻求使独立演化的组件满足一致性准则所需的最小路径空间扰动。

paragraphs.en: Despite using 2 20 2^{20} proposals per evaluation seed, conditionally normalised IS achieves a pre-resampling effective sample size (ESS) of only 99.6 ± 15.3 99.6\pm 15.3 , approximately 0.0095 % 0.0095\% of the proposal budget. paragraphs.en: This experiment is not reported in the main paper, but serves as a controlled testbed in which the coordination network can be trained cheaply, allowing us to study the method in detail from both theoretical and computational perspectives. In particular, it lets us isolate the effects of component factorisation, optimisation strategy, and reward design, and examine how different rewards trade off constraint satisfaction, diversity, and the amount of control required to steer the pretrained processes.
paragraphs.zh: 这项实验并未在主要论文中报告，但它作为一个受控测试平台，使得协调网络能够以低成本进行训练，从而让我们能够从理论和计算两个角度详细研究该方法。 具体来说，它使我们能够分别分析组件分解、优化策略和奖励设计所带来的影响，并考察不同奖励机制如何在满足约束、多样性和引导预训练过程所需控制量之间取得平衡。

paragraphs.en: We test two claims central to CMDS : whether a single amortised control can satisfy a family of relational constraints, and whether explicitly factorising the sampler by component simplifies relational steering. paragraphs.en: Two-square baseline. The two-square baseline has the correct object count, but not the right factorisation. It can generate two-square canvases, yet the control must still solve the assignment problem of which square should satisfy which part of the left/right and distance reward (below). This creates an ambiguous credit-assignment problem. The reward gradients act on the whole image rather than on separately addressable components. In contrast, CMDS builds the assignment into the sampler by using one component process per square and applying the reward after assembly, so the same global signal induces more targeted, lower-action coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 两格基线。 两格基线的对象数量正确，但分解方式不正确。 它可以生成两格画布，但控制机制仍需解决分配问题：即哪个方格应满足左右和距离奖励（如下）的哪一部分。 这造成了一个模糊的信用分配问题。 奖励梯度作用于整个图像，而非可单独处理的各个组件。 相比之下，CMDS 通过将每个方格分配一个组件进程，并在组装后应用奖励，将分配过程内建于采样器中；因此，相同的全局信号能引导更具针对性、更低层级的动作协调。

paragraphs.en: In this setting, we also compare against the two single-process baselines. The failure for the two-square baseline becomes more pronounced for the distance constraint, where validity depends on the relative barycentres of the two squares. A unique control can improve the reward by moving mass in reward-favourable ways, but it does not inherit the component-level separation that makes the desired relation easy to express and control. This failure is therefore an inductive-bias failure, not just a capacity failure. The two-square generator represents valid objects, but its representation does not expose the component assignments needed for least-action steering.
paragraphs.zh: 在此设定中，我们还与两种单进程基线模型进行了比较。 对于距离约束而言，双正方形基线模型的失效现象更为明显，因为有效性取决于两个正方形的相对重心。 一种独特的控制方式可以通过以有利于奖励的方式移动质量来提高奖励，但它并未继承那种使所需关系易于表达和控制的组件级分离特性。 因此，这种失效属于归纳偏置的失效，而不仅仅是容量不足导致的失效。 双正方形生成器能够表示有效的对象，但其表示方式并未揭示出实现最小动作引导所需的组件分配信息。

paragraphs.en: To test amortisation, we jointly train two agent-specific controllers with separate parameters, one acting on each frozen copy of the one-square reverse process, over d Δ ​ x ∈ { 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 } d_{\Delta x}\in\{3,4,5,6\} . The requested separation is represented by a four-way one-hot vector, broadcast over the spatial grid and concatenated to each controller input at every DDIM transition. Each controller outputs an additive residual to its corresponding frozen denoiser’s noise prediction, thereby steering the two component processes jointly under the shared assembly-level reward. As shown in fig. 14 , the amortised control steers the matched reference terminal proposals into valid assemblies, while the achieved separations closely match the requested targets. The discrete adjoint-matching formulation is provided in Section C.2.2 , and the control implementation is described below.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试摊销控制，我们联合训练了两个针对特定智能体的控制器，它们各自拥有独立的参数，每个控制器作用于一个方格反向过程的冻结副本，其中 d Δ ​ x ∈ { 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 } d_{\Delta x}\in\{3,4,5,6\}。 所要求的分离度由一个四元独热向量表示，该向量被广播到空间网格上，并在每次 DDIM 转换时与每个控制器的输入进行拼接。 每个控制器都会对其对应的冻结去噪器噪声预测输出一个可加残差，从而在共享的装配层级奖励下联合引导这两个组件过程。 如图 14 所示，摊销控制将匹配的参考终端提议引导至有效的装配结构，同时实际实现的分离度与所要求的目标高度一致。 离散伴随匹配公式见第 C.2.2 节，其控制实现将在下文进行描述。

paragraphs.en: Source separation seeks to recover two or more latent signals from a combined observation. In many cases, datasets of individual source types and datasets of mixtures may each be available, while paired examples containing a mixture together with its constituent sources are unavailable or difficult to obtain. We investigate whether CMDS can coordinate samplers trained independently on the individual source distributions to explain an observed mixture without requiring paired source–mixture training data. The objective is to recover components whose assembly matches the observation while each component remains consistent with its respective pretrained distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 源分离旨在从合并后的观测数据中恢复两个或更多潜在信号。 在许多情况下，可能分别拥有单个源类型的数据集和混合数据集，但包含混合体及其组成源的配对样本却不可用或难以获取。 我们研究 CMDS 是否能够协调在单个源分布上独立训练的采样器，从而无需配对源–混合训练数据即可解释观测到的混合体。 其目标是恢复出那些组合后与观测结果匹配，且每个分量都与其各自的预训练分布保持一致的组成部分。

paragraphs.en: The aggregate comparisons over 1024 1024 instances at τ = 0.5 \tau=0.5 (low blur) and τ = 1.0 \tau=1.0 (high blur) are shown in fig. 15 and fig. 4 , respectively. CMDS achieves the lowest reconstruction RMSE and highest source IoU while retaining the low shape distortion of the frozen component priors. Representative reconstructions for the low-blur setting are shown in fig. 16 ; corresponding results under the stronger blur τ = 1.0 \tau=1.0 are shown in fig. 17 . Under stronger blur, the observation contains less information about the locations of the individual components, and the recovered circle and square can therefore exchange their ground-truth locations, as illustrated in the fourth row of fig. 17 . Such decompositions preserve plausible component shapes and can produce a similar blurred assembly. The quadratic cost can consequently favour a nearby prior-consistent decomposition over the larger intervention required to recover the exact ground-truth placement.
paragraphs.zh: 在 τ = 0.5（低模糊度）和 τ = 1.0（高模糊度）条件下，对 1024 个实例进行的汇总比较分别展示于图 15 和图 4。 CMDS 实现了最低的重建 RMSE 和最高的源 IoU，同时保留了冻结组件先验的低形状失真特性。 低模糊度设置下的代表性重建结果展示于图 16；在更强模糊度 τ = 1.0 下的对应结果展示于图 17。 在更强模糊度下，观测信息包含的关于单个组件位置的信息更少，因此恢复出的圆形和方形可能会交换其真实位置，如圖 17 第四行所示。 此类分解能够保留合理的组件形状，并生成类似的模糊组合体。 因此，二次成本可能会倾向于选择邻近且与先验一致的分解方案，而非为恢复精确的真实位置所需的大范围调整。

paragraphs.en: Each layout uses a single-agent trajectory diffusion model, pretrained once and frozen throughout coordination training. We adopt the Diffusion Veteran configuration ( Lu et al., 2025 ) : a DiT-style denoiser with six adaLN-zero blocks, hidden width 256 256 , four attention heads, and ≈ 7.3 \approx 7.3 M parameters. The model is trained as a 100 100 -step discrete-time DDPM with a linear schedule and mean-squared ϵ \epsilon -prediction loss. This configuration reaches near-perfect ( ≈ 0.99 \approx 0.99 ) wall feasibility on both layouts.
paragraphs.zh: 每种布局都使用一个单智能体轨迹扩散模型，该模型经过一次预训练，并在整个协调训练过程中保持冻结。 我们采用了 Diffusion Veteran 配置（Lu et al., 2025）：一种 DiT 风格的去噪器，包含六个 adaLN-zero 块、隐藏层宽度为 256×256、四个注意力头以及约 7.3 M 个参数。 该模型被训练为一个 100 步离散时间 DDPM，采用线性调度方案和均方 ϵ-预测损失。 这种配置在两种布局上都实现了近乎完美（约 0.99）的墙体可行性。

paragraphs.en: The pretrained diffusion model represents each trajectory as a residual correction to the straight-line path between the start and goal. Before passing the trajectory to the control network, we reconstruct the corresponding absolute ( x , y ) (x,y) positions in the maze. Cross-agent attention therefore operates on the agents’ predicted physical positions rather than on the residual representation used by the diffusion model. At reverse transition ℓ \ell , it receives the joint trajectory Z ℓ Z_{\ell} , the reconstructed Tweedie estimate Z ^ 1 | ℓ \hat{Z}_{1\mid\ell} , the start–goal conditions κ \kappa , and the native diffusion time-step ζ ℓ \zeta_{\ell} . The trajectory and Tweedie estimate are concatenated along the channel axis and projected to width 344 344 , with sinusoidal embeddings of diffusion time and physical waypoint position. An initial temporal self-attention block processes each agent’s trajectory separately. Two axial blocks then alternate temporal self-attention within each agent, cross-agent attention at each shared waypoint, and a feed-forward layer. Both blocks retain the full waypoint resolution and use four attention heads, a feed-forward multiplier of 4 4 , residual connections, and layer normalisation. Cross-agent attention includes a learned geometric bias. For each agent pair, an eight-dimensional feature collects relative position ( 2 2 ), distance ( 1 1 ), forward-differenced relative velocity ( 2 2 ), closing speed ( 1 1 ), and relative goal offset ( 2 2 ). An MLP with dimensions → → 4 8\!\to\!32\!\to\!4 maps these features to an additive bias for each attention head, applied through a custom scaled-dot-product implementation. Separate output heads read the local and communication representations to produce the epsilon residual δ ​ ϵ θ , ℓ \delta\epsilon_{\theta,\ell} . Both heads and the final layer of the geometric-bias MLP are zero-initialised, so the base control initially leaves the pretrained sampler unchanged. The network has ∼ 4.3 \sim 4.3 M parameters. Rather than applying attention jointly over all N × H N\times H agent–waypoint tokens, we factor it along the two natural axes of the trajectory tensor ( Ho et al., 2019 ) : temporal attention operates over waypoints within each agent, while cross-agent attention operates over agents at each shared waypoint. This reduces the per-block attention complexity from O ⁡ ( N 2 ​ H 2 ) O(N^{2}H^{2}) to O ⁡ ( N ​ H ​ ( N + H ) ) O(NH(N+H)) .
paragraphs.zh: 预训练的扩散模型将每条轨迹表示为起点与终点之间直线路径的残差修正。 在将轨迹传入控制网络之前，我们会重构迷宫中对应的绝对 (x, y) 位置。 因此，跨智能体注意力操作的对象是智能体预测的物理位置，而非扩散模型使用的残差表示。 在反向过渡 ℓ 时，它会接收联合轨迹 Z_ℓ、重构的 Tweedie 估计值 \hat{Z}_{1\mid\ell}、起点–终点条件 κ 以及原生扩散时间步 ζ_ℓ。 轨迹与 Tweedie 估计值沿通道轴拼接，并投影至宽度为 344，同时加入扩散时间和物理路径点位置的正弦嵌入。 一个初始的时间自注意力模块会分别处理每个智能体的轨迹。 随后，两个轴向模块交替执行：在每个智能体内进行时间自注意力，在每个共享路径点上执行跨智能体注意力，并加入前馈层。 两个模块均保留完整的路径点分辨率，并使用四个注意力头、4 倍的前馈乘数、残差连接和层归一化。 跨智能体注意力包含一个可学习的几何偏置。 对于每对智能体，一个八维特征会收集相对位置（2 维）、距离（1 维）、前向差分后的相对速度（2 维）、接近速度（1 维）以及相对目标偏移量（2 维）。 一个维度为 4→32→4 的 MLP 将这些特征映射到每个注意力头的加性偏置，并通过自定义的缩放点积实现应用。 独立的输出头分别读取局部表示和通信表示，以生成 ε 残差 δ_ε_{θ,ℓ}。 两个输出头以及几何偏置 MLP 的最终层均采用零初始化，因此基础控制最初不会改变预训练的采样器。 该网络约有 4.3 M 个参数。 我们并未在所有 N×H 个智能体–路径点标记上联合应用注意力，而是沿轨迹张量的两个自然轴进行分解（Ho et al., 2019）：时间注意力作用于每个智能体内的路径点，而跨智能体注意力则作用于每个共享路径点上的不同智能体。 这将每个注意力模块的复杂度从 O(N²H²) 降低至 O(NH(N+H))。

sents.en: The pretrained diffusion model represents each trajectory as a residual correction to the straight-line path between the start and goal.

sents.zh: 因此，跨智能体注意力操作的对象是智能体预测的物理位置，而非扩散模型使用的残差表示。

paragraphs.en: We apply the adjoint matching coordination objective introduced in section 2.1 to the stacked N N -agent state. Adjoint matching rolls out the current controlled trajectory along the reverse grid with no gradient tracking. Starting from the terminal cost gradient a K = ∇ X K [ − λ ​ r κ ​ ( Y K ) ] a_{K}=\nabla_{X_{K}}[-\lambda r_{\kappa}(Y_{K})] , it propagates an adjoint variable backward one DDIM step at a time. This backward pass replays individual controlled transitions rather than retaining the computational graph of the full multi-step sampler. The control is then trained to match the correction implied by the next-state adjoint a ℓ + 1 a_{\ell+1} . All headline results use the robust regression variant described in section D.4.7 . At low signal-to-noise ratios, the DiT prior can also produce excessively large X ^ 1 | ℓ \hat{X}_{1\mid\ell} estimates; following Janner et al. (2022) , we clip X ^ 1 | ℓ \hat{X}_{1\mid\ell} before converting it back to the equivalent noise prediction used in the control-penalty decomposition.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将第 2.1 节中引入的伴随匹配协调目标应用于堆叠的 N 个智能体的状态。 伴随匹配沿着反向网格展开当前的受控轨迹，且不进行梯度跟踪。 从终端成本梯度 a K = ∇ X K [ − λ ​ r κ ​ ( Y K ) ] a_{K}=\nabla_{X_{K}}[-\lambda r_{\kappa}(Y_{K})] 开始，它每次向后传播一个 DDIM 步的伴随变量。 这种反向传播会重播单个受控转换，而不是保留完整多步采样器的计算图。 随后，控制器将被训练以匹配下一状态伴随变量 a ℓ + 1 a_{\ell+1} 所隐含的修正。 所有主要结果均使用了第 D.4.7 节中描述的稳健回归变体。 在低信噪比条件下，DiT 先验也可能产生过大 X ^ 1 | ℓ \hat{X}_{1\mid\ell} 的估计值；遵循 Janner 等人 (2022) 的方法，我们在将其转换回控制惩罚分解中使用的等效噪声预测之前，对 X ^ 1 | ℓ \hat{X}_{1\mid\ell} 进行了裁剪。

paragraphs.en: Adjoint matching is an on-policy stochastic regression problem whose inputs and targets depend on the current control. Because adjoints are propagated through Jacobians evaluated along stochastic, control-dependent trajectories, finite-batch gradient estimates can have high variance despite being unbiased in expectation ( Domingo-Enrich et al., 2025 ) . The squared matching loss can amplify this variability because its gradient grows with the adjoint residual. For collision rewards, early trajectories often contain persistent agent collisions or deep wall penetrations, which can dominate minibatch adjoints and make optimisation unstable and strongly seed-dependent. This motivates a modification of adjoint matching’s regression objective.
paragraphs.zh: 伴随匹配是一种在线策略随机回归问题，其输入和目标取决于当前的控制。 由于伴随变量是通过沿随机且依赖于控制的轨迹计算的雅可比矩阵传播的，有限批次的梯度估计尽管在期望上无偏，但仍可能具有较大的方差（Domingo-Enrich 等人，2025）。 平方匹配损失会放大这种变异性，因为其梯度会随着伴随残差的增长而增大。 对于碰撞奖励而言，早期轨迹通常包含持续的智能体碰撞或深度穿墙现象，这些情况可能主导小批次的伴随变量，导致优化过程不稳定且高度依赖初始种子。 这促使我们对伴随匹配的回归目标进行修改。

paragraphs.en: The KUKA task follows Luo et al. (2024) and consists of two robotic arms whose single-arm trajectory priors are independently pretrained for obstacle-avoiding motion planning. Arm i i generates joint angles q i = ( q 1 i , … , q H i ) ∈ ℝ H × 7 q^{i}=(q^{i}_{1},\ldots,q^{i}_{H})\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times 7} , with H = 56 H=56 . All arms share a path-progress coordinate, and q 1 i , q H i q^{i}_{1},q^{i}_{H} are fixed to the requested start and goal. The planner generates joint-angle paths without assigning physical times to their waypoints or enforcing joint-velocity limits. Evaluation checks geometric constraints, including joint limits and collisions along trajectories. With the saved prior-normalisation bounds q lo , q hi q_{\mathrm{lo}},q_{\mathrm{hi}} , the normalised full path is x = 2 ​ ( q − q lo ) / ( q hi − q lo ) − 1 x=2(q-q_{\mathrm{lo}})/(q_{\mathrm{hi}}-q_{\mathrm{lo}})-1 , with component-wise operations and an affine inverse. Only the H − 2 H-2 interior knots are sampled; endpoints are reinserted whenever the full trajectory is reconstructed. We denote the joint native state by X = ( X 1 , … , X N ) X=(X^{1},\ldots,X^{N}) , where X i ∈ ℝ ( H − 2 ) × 7 X^{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{(H-2)\times 7} contains arm i i ’s normalised interior coordinates. For fixed task conditions κ \kappa , comprising the endpoints, arm bases, and obstacles, the reconstructed assembly is Y = φ ⁡ ( X ) = q = ( q 1 , … , q N ) Y=\varphi(X)=q=(q^{1},\ldots,q^{N}) ; the dependence of φ \varphi on κ \kappa is suppressed. The two-arm state has 14 ​ ( H − 2 ) ≈ 750 14(H-2)\approx 750 free coordinates. For N N arms, D = 7 ​ N ​ ( H − 2 ) D=7N(H-2) ; norms on the native state and control are Euclidean after vectorisation, without averaging over arms or coordinates.
paragraphs.zh: KUKA 任务遵循 Luo 等人（2024）的研究，由两个机械臂组成，其单臂轨迹先验分别独立预训练用于避障运动规划。机械臂 i 生成关节角 q i = ( q 1 i , … , q H i ) ∈ ℝ H × 7 q^{i}=(q^{i}_{1},\ldots,q^{i}_{H})\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times 7}，其中 H = 56。所有机械臂共享一个路径进展坐标，且 q 1 i , q H i 固定为指定的起始点和目标点。规划器生成关节角路径时，不会为其路径点分配物理时间，也不会强制执行关节速度限制。评估过程会检查几何约束，包括关节限位和沿轨迹的碰撞。利用保存的先验归一化边界 q lo , q hi q_{\mathrm{lo}},q_{\mathrm{hi}}，归一化的完整路径为 x = 2 ​ ( q − q lo ) / ( q hi − q lo ) − 1 x=2(q-q_{\mathrm{lo}})/(q_{\mathrm{hi}}-q_{\mathrm{lo}})-1，其中涉及逐元素运算和仿射逆变换。仅对 H − 2 个内部节点进行采样；在重构完整轨迹时，端点会被重新插入。我们将关节原始状态表示为 X = ( X 1 , … , X N ) X=(X^{1},\ldots,X^{N})，其中 X i ∈ ℝ ( H − 2 ) × 7 X^{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{(H-2)\times 7} 包含机械臂 i 的归一化内部坐标。对于固定的任务条件 κ（包括端点、机械臂基座和障碍物），重构后的装配体为 Y = φ ⁡ ( X ) = q = ( q 1 , … , q N ) Y=\varphi(X)=q=(q^{1},\ldots,q^{N})；此处省略了 φ 对 κ 的依赖关系。双臂状态包含 14 ​ ( H − 2 ) ≈ 750 个自由坐标。对于 N 个机械臂，D = 7 ​ N ​ ( H − 2 )；原始状态和控制量的范数在向量化后采用欧几里得范数，且不对机械臂或坐标进行平均。

paragraphs.en: The arm bases are positioned at ( − 0.5 , 0 , 0 ) (-0.5,0,0) and ( 0.5 , 0 , 0 ) (0.5,0,0) metres, with both bases’ local coordinate axes aligned with the world axes. The scene contains a shared table beneath the arms and five cubic obstacles, each with side length 0.44 ​ m 0.44\,\mathrm{m} and edges aligned with the world axes.
paragraphs.zh: 机械臂的基座位于 (−0.5, 0, 0) 和 (0.5, 0, 0) 米处，且两个基座的局部坐标轴均与世界坐标轴对齐。 场景中包含一个位于机械臂下方的共享桌面以及五个立方体障碍物，每个障碍物的边长为 0.44 m，且其边与世界坐标轴对齐。

paragraphs.en: Single-arm priors receive obstacle centres expressed in each arm’s local base coordinates; the controller and collision reward use world-frame (i.e. shared coordinate system) forward kinematics and the actual obstacle extents. The pretrained conditioning interface remains fixed, while the joint control observes the transformed scene.
paragraphs.zh: 单臂先验接收以各手臂局部基座坐标表示的障碍物中心；控制器和碰撞奖励使用世界坐标系（即共享坐标系）的正向运动学以及障碍物的实际范围。 预训练的条件接口保持固定，而关节控制则观察经过转换的场景。

sents.en: Single-arm priors receive obstacle centres expressed in each arm’s local base coordinates; the controller and collision reward use world-frame (i.e. shared coordinate system) forward kinematics and the actual obstacle extents.
sents.zh: 单臂先验接收以各手臂局部基座坐标表示的障碍物中心；控制器和碰撞奖励使用世界坐标系（即共享坐标系）的正向运动学以及障碍物的实际范围。

sents.en: The pretrained conditioning interface remains fixed, while the joint control observes the transformed scene.
sents.zh: 预训练的条件接口保持固定，而关节控制则观察经过转换的场景。

paragraphs.en: We instantiate the priors from the pretrained checkpoints of Luo et al. (2024) . The Dual-arm checkpoint is used only for evaluation and comparison with CMDS † † † https://github.com/devinluo27/potential-motion-plan-release .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 Luo 等人（2024）的预训练检查点中实例化先验。 双臂检查点仅用于评估以及与 CMDS † † † https://github.com/devinluo27/potential-motion-plan-release 的比较。

sents.en: We instantiate the priors from the pretrained checkpoints of Luo et al. (2024) .
sents.zh: 我们从 Luo 等人（2024）的预训练检查点中实例化先验。

sents.en: The Dual-arm checkpoint is used only for evaluation and comparison with CMDS † † † https://github.com/devinluo27/potential-motion-plan-release .
sents.zh: 双臂检查点仅用于评估以及与 CMDS † † † https://github.com/devinluo27/potential-motion-plan-release 的比较。

paragraphs.en: A layout specifies the obstacle arrangement, while a planning task specifies start and goal configurations for both arms within that layout. The released dataset provides separate training and test layouts. We divide its 2,500 training layouts into 2,250 layouts for learning the controller and 250 layouts reserved for validation. Validation is used to monitor training and select controller settings and guidance strengths. Test layouts are used to report performance. These three groups contain no shared layouts.
paragraphs.zh: 布局定义了障碍物的排列方式，而规划任务则在该布局中为两条手臂指定了起始和目标的构型。 发布的数据集提供了独立的训练布局和测试布局。 我们将其中 2,500 个训练布局划分为 2,250 个用于学习控制器的布局和 250 个保留用于验证的布局。 验证用于监控训练过程，并选择控制器的设置和引导强度。 测试布局用于报告性能表现。 这三个组别之间没有任何共享的布局。

sents.en: A layout specifies the obstacle arrangement, while a planning task specifies start and goal configurations for both arms within that layout.
sents.zh: 布局定义了障碍物的排列方式，而规划任务则在该布局中为两条手臂指定了起始和目标的构型。

sents.en: The released dataset provides separate training and test layouts.
sents.zh: 发布的数据集提供了独立的训练布局和测试布局。

sents.en: We divide its 2,500 training layouts into 2,250 layouts for learning the controller and 250 layouts reserved for validation.
sents.zh: 我们将其中 2,500 个训练布局划分为 2,250 个用于学习控制器的布局和 250 个保留用于验证的布局。

sents.en: Validation is used to monitor training and select controller settings and guidance strengths.
sents.zh: 验证用于监控训练过程，并选择控制器的设置和引导强度。

sents.en: Test layouts are used to report performance.
sents.zh: 测试布局用于报告性能表现。

sents.en: These three groups contain no shared layouts.
sents.zh: 这三个组别之间没有任何共享的布局。

paragraphs.en: For controller training, we extract 32 start–goal pairs from each of the 2,250 training layouts, giving 72,000 tasks. Removing tasks whose start or goal configurations violate joint limits or contain collisions leaves 50 thousand training tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在控制器训练过程中，我们从 2,250 个训练布局中分别提取 32 对起点–终点组合，共得到 72,000 项任务。 移除那些起点或终点配置违反关节限制或存在碰撞的任务后，剩余 5 万项训练任务。

sents.en: For controller training, we extract 32 start–goal pairs from each of the 2,250 training layouts, giving 72,000 tasks.
sents.zh: 在控制器训练过程中，我们从 2,250 个训练布局中分别提取 32 对起点–终点组合，共得到 72,000 项任务。

sents.en: Removing tasks whose start or goal configurations violate joint limits or contain collisions leaves 50 thousand training tasks.
sents.zh: 移除那些起点或终点配置违反关节限制或存在碰撞的任务后，剩余 5 万项训练任务。

paragraphs.en: For validation, we select two tasks from each of 100 of the 250 reserved layouts. For testing, we select two tasks from each of 300 released test layouts. Applying the same endpoint checks leaves 134 validation tasks and 413 test tasks, with the latter spanning 264 layouts. All methods use the same retained tasks, selected before planner evaluation. Collision-free start and goal configurations do not guarantee that a collision-free path exists between them.
paragraphs.zh: 在验证阶段，我们从 250 个预留布局中的每个布局选择两个任务。 在测试阶段，我们从 300 个已发布的测试布局中的每个布局选择两个任务。 应用相同的端点检查后，剩余 134 个验证任务和 413 个测试任务，其中后者覆盖了 264 个布局。 所有方法都使用相同的保留任务，这些任务在规划器评估之前就已选定。 无碰撞的起始和目标配置并不保证两者之间存在无碰撞的路径。

sents.en: For validation, we select two tasks from each of 100 of the 250 reserved layouts.
sents.zh: 在验证阶段，我们从 250 个预留布局中的每个布局选择两个任务。

sents.en: For testing, we select two tasks from each of 300 released test layouts.
sents.zh: 在测试阶段，我们从 300 个已发布的测试布局中的每个布局选择两个任务。

sents.en: Applying the same endpoint checks leaves 134 validation tasks and 413 test tasks, with the latter spanning 264 layouts.
sents.zh: 应用相同的端点检查后，剩余 134 个验证任务和 413 个测试任务，其中后者覆盖了 264 个布局。

sents.en: All methods use the same retained tasks, selected before planner evaluation.
sents.zh: 所有方法都使用相同的保留任务，这些任务在规划器评估之前就已选定。

sents.en: Collision-free start and goal configurations do not guarantee that a collision-free path exists between them.
sents.zh: 无碰撞的起始和目标配置并不保证两者之间存在无碰撞的路径。

paragraphs.en: Each transformation below is applied to all test configurations. Obstacle perturbations are deterministic per layout and shared across methods. All controller and prior weights and guidance strengths are held fixed. The resulting number of tasks after feasibility filtering is detailed in table 11 .
paragraphs.zh: 以下每种变换都会应用于所有测试配置。 障碍物扰动在每个布局中是确定性的，并且所有方法共享同一扰动。 所有控制器、先验权重和引导强度均保持固定不变。 可行性筛选后得到的任务数量详见表 11。

sents.en: Each transformation below is applied to all test configurations.
sents.zh: 以下每种变换都会应用于所有测试配置。

sents.en: Obstacle perturbations are deterministic per layout and shared across methods.
sents.zh: 障碍物扰动在每个布局中是确定性的，并且所有方法共享同一扰动。

sents.en: All controller and prior weights and guidance strengths are held fixed.
sents.zh: 所有控制器、先验权重和引导强度均保持固定不变。

sents.en: The resulting number of tasks after feasibility filtering is detailed in table 11 .
sents.zh: 可行性筛选后得到的任务数量详见表 11。

paragraphs.en: For wider bases, joint-space endpoints and world-frame obstacle positions remain fixed, so world-space end-effector endpoints change.
paragraphs.zh: 对于更宽的基座，关节空间端点和世界坐标系的障碍物位置保持固定，因此世界空间末端执行器的端点会发生变化。

paragraphs.en: CMDS is architecturally compatible with an arbitrary number of arms without retraining. For the arm-count comparison in the right-hand block of table 3 , we select twenty start–goal tasks from each of the 300 test layouts, giving 6,000 tasks. Selection is fixed before running any planner. We keep the original two arms and obstacles unchanged, then add arms at ( 0 , 0.8 , 0 ) (0,0.8,0) , ( 0 , − 0.8 , 0 ) (0,-0.8,0) , and ( 0.8 , 0.8 , 0 ) (0.8,0.8,0) metres, all with the same base orientation as the original arms. Within each layout, we pair consecutive tasks in the fixed selection order. We assign endpoints to the added arms using other two-arm tasks from the same obstacle layout. We pair the twenty selected tasks in their fixed order: the first with the second, the third with the fourth, and so on. For each task, arm three receives the start and goal joint angles of the paired task’s first arm; arm four receives those of its second arm. Arm five receives the first arm’s start and goal joint angles from a third task. We select this third task from all released tasks in the same layout, sorted by task identifier, taking the first entry other than the current task, its paired task, or either of the two tasks used in the original two-arm benchmark. Only endpoint joint angles are reused; trajectories are generated anew for each arm count.
paragraphs.zh: CMDS 在架构上与任意数量的机械臂兼容，无需重新训练。 对于表 3 右侧区块中的机械臂数量对比，我们从 300 种测试布局的每种布局中选取二十个起点–终点任务，共得到 6,000 个任务。 在运行任何规划器之前，选择过程就已固定。 我们保留原有的两个机械臂和障碍物不变，然后在 (0, 0.8, 0)、(0, -0.8, 0) 和 (0.8, 0.8, 0) 米处添加机械臂，所有新增机械臂都与原始机械臂具有相同的基座朝向。 在每种布局内部，我们按照固定的选择顺序将连续的任务进行配对。 我们使用来自同一障碍物布局的其他双机械臂任务，为新增的机械臂分配终点。 我们按照固定的顺序对选定的二十个任务进行配对：第一个与第二个配对，第三个与第四个配对，以此类推。 对于每个任务，机械臂三接收所配对的任务的第一个机械臂的起点和终点关节角度；机械臂四则接收该任务第二个机械臂的对应角度。 机械臂五接收来自第三个任务的第一个机械臂的起点和终点关节角度。 我们从同一布局中所有已释放的任务里选择这个第三个任务，这些任务按任务标识符排序，并选取当前任务、其配对任务或原始双机械臂基准测试中使用的两个任务之外的第一个条目。 仅重复使用终点关节角度；对于每种机械臂数量，轨迹都会重新生成。

sents.en: CMDS is architecturally compatible with an arbitrary number of arms without retraining.
sents.zh: CMDS 在架构上与任意数量的机械臂兼容，无需重新训练。

sents.en: For the arm-count comparison in the right-hand block of table 3 , we select twenty start–goal tasks from each of the 300 test layouts, giving 6,000 tasks.
sents.zh: 对于表 3 右侧区块中的机械臂数量对比，我们从 300 种测试布局的每种布局中选取二十个起点–终点任务，共得到 6,000 个任务。

sents.en: Selection is fixed before running any planner.
sents.zh: 在运行任何规划器之前，选择过程就已固定。

sents.en: We keep the original two arms and obstacles unchanged, then add arms at ( 0 , 0.8 , 0 ) (0,0.8,0) , ( 0 , − 0.8 , 0 ) (0,-0.8,0) , and ( 0.8 , 0.8 , 0 ) (0.8,0.8,0) metres, all with the same base orientation as the original arms.
sents.zh: 我们保留原有的两个机械臂和障碍物不变，然后在 (0, 0.8, 0)、(0, -0.8, 0) 和 (0.8, 0.8, 0) 米处添加机械臂，所有新增机械臂都与原始机械臂具有相同的基座朝向。

sents.en: Within each layout, we pair consecutive tasks in the fixed selection order.
sents.zh: 在每种布局内部，我们按照固定的选择顺序将连续的任务进行配对。

sents.en: We assign endpoints to the added arms using other two-arm tasks from the same obstacle layout.
sents.zh: 我们使用来自同一障碍物布局的其他双机械臂任务，为新增的机械臂分配终点。

sents.en: We pair the twenty selected tasks in their fixed order: the first with the second, the third with the fourth, and so on.
sents.zh: 我们按照固定的顺序对选定的二十个任务进行配对：第一个与第二个配对，第三个与第四个配对，以此类推。

sents.en: For each task, arm three receives the start and goal joint angles of the paired task’s first arm; arm four receives those of its second arm.
sents.zh: 对于每个任务，机械臂三接收所配对的任务的第一个机械臂的起点和终点关节角度；机械臂四则接收该任务第二个机械臂的对应角度。

sents.en: Arm five receives the first arm’s start and goal joint angles from a third task.
sents.zh: 机械臂五接收来自第三个任务的第一个机械臂的起点和终点关节角度。

sents.en: We select this third task from all released tasks in the same layout, sorted by task identifier, taking the first entry other than the current task, its paired task, or either of the two tasks used in the original two-arm benchmark.
sents.zh: 我们从同一布局中所有已释放的任务里选择这个第三个任务，这些任务按任务标识符排序，并选取当前任务、其配对任务或原始双机械臂基准测试中使用的两个任务之外的第一个条目。

sents.en: Only endpoint joint angles are reused; trajectories are generated anew for each arm count.
sents.zh: 仅重复使用终点关节角度；对于每种机械臂数量，轨迹都会重新生成。

paragraphs.en: Checking joint limits and endpoint collisions leaves 4 thousands 1,5 thousand, 500, and 200 tasks for two, three, four, and five arms, respectively. We compare all arm counts on the same 209 tasks whose endpoints pass these checks in every setting. These results are conditional on endpoint feasibility for all four counts; they do not describe the full retained population at each count or certify that a feasible connecting path exists.
paragraphs.zh: 检查关节极限和端点碰撞后，对于两个、三个、四个和五个机械臂，分别剩余 4000、1500、500 和 200 项任务。 在所有设置中，我们比较了所有机械臂数量在通过上述检查的相同 209 项任务上的表现。 这些结果以所有四种机械臂数量下端点的可行性为前提；它们并未描述每种数量下完整的保留任务集，也未证明存在可行的连接路径。

sents.en: We compare all arm counts on the same 209 tasks whose endpoints pass these checks in every setting.
sents.zh: 在所有设置中，我们比较了所有机械臂数量在通过上述检查的相同 209 项任务上的表现。

paragraphs.en: We use the discrete adjoint recursion and matching loss of Section C.2.2 . The control cost is averaged over arms, and the collision reward has weight β = 40 \beta=40 . Adjoints propagate through all ten denoising transitions, while control costs and matching terms involve only the nine stochastic transitions. Since ϵ ψ = ∇ x E ψ \epsilon_{\psi}=\nabla_{x}E_{\psi} , the required vector–Jacobian products through the noise predictor are Hessian–vector products through the energy. We compute these by locally recomputing each transition with input differentiation enabled and checkpoint parameters frozen. The clean predictions, reward-gradient directions, and auxiliary geometry supplied to the controller are detached during this differentiation. The calibrated pseudo-Huber matching loss is specified in Section D.5.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了 C.2.2 节中的离散伴随递归和匹配损失。 控制成本在所有臂上取平均，而碰撞奖励的权重为 β = 40 \beta=40。 伴随变量通过全部十个去噪转换传播，而控制成本和匹配项仅涉及九个随机转换。 由于 ϵ ψ = ∇ x E ψ \epsilon_{\psi}=\nabla_{x}E_{\psi}，因此噪声预测器中所需的向量-雅可比积实际上是能量中的海森矩阵-向量积。 我们通过启用输入微分并冻结检查点参数，局部重新计算每个转换来得到这些结果。 在此微分过程中，提供给控制器的干净预测、奖励梯度方向和辅助几何信息均被解耦。 校准后的伪-Huber 匹配损失在 D.5.3 节中进行了说明。

paragraphs.en: The controller follows the same implementation detailed in section D.4.5 . Inputs include the noisy state, detached clean prediction, normalised reward gradient, endpoint and base conditions, and local kinematic features. During cross-arm attention, the controller uses the relative positions of each pair of arms, their clearance, goals, base positions, and motion to adjust how much attention they give each other. Consequently, the same controller can process an additional arm without changing parameter dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 控制器遵循 D.4.5 节中详细说明的相同实现。 输入包括带噪声的状态、分离后的干净预测、归一化的奖励梯度、端点和基座条件，以及局部运动学特征。 在跨臂注意力机制中，控制器利用每对手臂的相对位置、它们之间的间距、目标、基座位置和运动，来调整它们相互给予的注意力程度。 因此，相同的控制器可以在不改变参数维度的情况下处理额外的手臂。

sents.en: The controller follows the same implementation detailed in section D.4.5 .
sents.zh: 控制器遵循 D.4.5 节中详细说明的相同实现。

sents.en: Inputs include the noisy state, detached clean prediction, normalised reward gradient, endpoint and base conditions, and local kinematic features.
sents.zh: 输入包括带噪声的状态、分离后的干净预测、归一化的奖励梯度、端点和基座条件，以及局部运动学特征。

sents.en: During cross-arm attention, the controller uses the relative positions of each pair of arms, their clearance, goals, base positions, and motion to adjust how much attention they give each other.
sents.zh: 在跨臂注意力机制中，控制器利用每对手臂的相对位置、它们之间的间距、目标、基座位置和运动，来调整它们相互给予的注意力程度。

sents.en: Consequently, the same controller can process an additional arm without changing parameter dimensions.
sents.zh: 因此，相同的控制器可以在不改变参数维度的情况下处理额外的手臂。

paragraphs.en: The controller is parameterised using the Tweedie reward gradient, CMDS +TRG; see eq. 114 , and uses the pseudo-Huber loss in section D.4.7 . Detailed parameters are provided in table 12 .

paragraphs.en: Single-arm KUKA samples each arm independently using the same frozen prior as CMDS ; Dual KUKA uses the released joint prior. Single-arm sampling uses η = 1 \eta=1 ; Dual KUKA retains its native η = 0 \eta=0 sampler. We also evaluated single-arm sampling with η = 0 \eta=0 , but it did not improve performance. Except for PBDM, methods return the first candidate that passes the common collision and endpoint checks.
paragraphs.zh: 单臂 KUKA 使用与 CMDS 相同的冻结先验独立地对每个手臂进行采样；双臂 KUKA 则使用已释放的关节先验。 单臂采样使用 η = 1 \eta=1；双臂 KUKA 保留其默认的 η = 0 \eta=0 采样器。 我们还评估了 η = 0 \eta=0 的单臂采样，但并未提升性能。 除了 PBDM，其他方法都会返回第一个通过通用碰撞和端点检查的候选方案。

sents.en: Single-arm KUKA samples each arm independently using the same frozen prior as CMDS ; Dual KUKA uses the released joint prior.

sents.en: Single-arm sampling uses η = 1 \eta=1 ; Dual KUKA retains its native η = 0 \eta=0 sampler.
sents.zh: 单臂采样使用 η = 1 \eta=1；双臂 KUKA 保留其默认的 η = 0 \eta=0 采样器。

sents.en: We also evaluated single-arm sampling with η = 0 \eta=0 , but it did not improve performance.
sents.zh: 我们还评估了 η = 0 \eta=0 的单臂采样，但并未提升性能。

sents.en: Except for PBDM, methods return the first candidate that passes the common collision and endpoint checks.
sents.zh: 除了 PBDM，其他方法都会返回第一个通过通用碰撞和端点检查的候选方案。

paragraphs.en: Guided single-arm and joint priors use the same collision reward as CMDS , with gradient scale 0.6 on the first nine DDIM transitions. The reward gradient is evaluated at the predicted clean path, without backpropagating through the prior. The guidance strength was selected from { 0.1 , 0.3 , 0.6 , 1.0 , 1.7 } \{0.1,0.3,0.6,1.0,1.7\} by validation success across n cand ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } n_{\mathrm{cand}}\in\{1,2,3,4\} initial noises, then fixed for all tests.

sents.zh: 奖励梯度在预测的干净路径上进行评估，而不会通过先验进行反向传播。

sents.en: The guidance strength was selected from { 0.1 , 0.3 , 0.6 , 1.0 , 1.7 } \{0.1,0.3,0.6,1.0,1.7\} by validation success across n cand ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } n_{\mathrm{cand}}\in\{1,2,3,4\} initial noises, then fixed for all tests.
sents.zh: 引导强度从 { 0.1 , 0.3 , 0.6 , 1.0 , 1.7 } \{0.1,0.3,0.6,1.0,1.7\} 中选出，依据的是在 n cand ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } n_{\mathrm{cand}}\in\{1,2,3,4\} 个初始噪声上的验证成功率，之后在所有测试中保持固定。

paragraphs.en: PBDM uses the released joint prior and planning procedure ( Luo et al., 2024 ) . The release defaults to 20 initial candidates with refinement disabled; our main PBDM results enable its optional refinement with the stated candidate budget n cand n_{\mathrm{cand}} equal to 1 or 4, matching the number of initial noise samples drawn by the other methods.
paragraphs.zh: PBDM 使用了已发布的联合先验和规划流程（Luo 等人，2024）。 发布版本默认包含 20 个初始候选项且禁用优化；我们主要的 PBDM 结果支持对其可选优化，其中声明的候选项预算 n_cand n_{\mathrm{cand}} 等于 1 或 4，与其他方法抽取的初始噪声样本数量一致。

sents.en: PBDM uses the released joint prior and planning procedure ( Luo et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: PBDM 使用了已发布的联合先验和规划流程（Luo 等人，2024）。

sents.en: The release defaults to 20 initial candidates with refinement disabled; our main PBDM results enable its optional refinement with the stated candidate budget n cand n_{\mathrm{cand}} equal to 1 or 4, matching the number of initial noise samples drawn by the other methods.
sents.zh: 发布版本默认包含 20 个初始候选项且禁用优化；我们主要的 PBDM 结果支持对其可选优化，其中声明的候选项预算 n_cand n_{\mathrm{cand}} 等于 1 或 4，与其他方法抽取的初始噪声样本数量一致。

paragraphs.en: Generate n cand n_{\mathrm{cand}} candidates and return the first accepted by PBDM’s own checker.
paragraphs.zh: 生成 n 个和 n_{\mathrm{cand}} 个候选项，并返回第一个被 PBDM 自身检查器接受的候选项。

paragraphs.en: If none passes, try the first min ⁡ ( n cand , 6 ) \min(n_{\mathrm{cand}},6) candidates in order, allowing up to R = 5 R=5 repair attempts each. Repair partially re-noises a path and applies three DDIM steps. Return the first accepted repaired path, or report failure.
paragraphs.zh: 如果没有通过，则按顺序尝试前 min(n_cand, 6) 个候选方案，每个方案最多允许 R = 5 次修复尝试。 修复会部分重新引入噪声到路径中，并应用三个 DDIM 步骤。 返回第一个被接受的修复后的路径，或报告失败。

sents.en: If none passes, try the first min ⁡ ( n cand , 6 ) \min(n_{\mathrm{cand}},6) candidates in order, allowing up to R = 5 R=5 repair attempts each.
sents.zh: 如果没有通过，则按顺序尝试前 min(n_cand, 6) 个候选方案，每个方案最多允许 R = 5 次修复尝试。

sents.en: Repair partially re-noises a path and applies three DDIM steps.
sents.zh: 修复会部分重新引入噪声到路径中，并应用三个 DDIM 步骤。

sents.en: Return the first accepted repaired path, or report failure.
sents.zh: 返回第一个被接受的修复后的路径，或报告失败。

paragraphs.en: Evaluate the returned path with our common strict checker. Success requires passing both checks; strict rejection does not trigger another candidate or repair.
paragraphs.zh: 使用我们共同的严格检查器来评估返回的路径。 成功需要同时通过两项检查；严格拒绝不会触发另一个候选方案或修复。

sents.en: Evaluate the returned path with our common strict checker.
sents.zh: 使用我们共同的严格检查器来评估返回的路径。

sents.en: Success requires passing both checks; strict rejection does not trigger another candidate or repair.
sents.zh: 成功需要同时通过两项检查；严格拒绝不会触发另一个候选方案或修复。

paragraphs.en: The budget n cand n_{\mathrm{cand}} excludes repair attempts, but planning time includes all repair and checking.
paragraphs.zh: 预算 n 和 n_{\mathrm{cand}} 不包括修复尝试，但规划时间则包含所有修复和检查。

paragraphs.en: This baseline uses independent single-arm priors. During repair, the released partial denoiser runs separately for each arm. Joint segments are accepted using PBDM’s rules, with three repair attempts and three denoising steps per attempt. The adaptation is applied to three to five arms.
paragraphs.zh: 该基线方法使用独立的单臂先验。 在修复过程中，释放的部分去噪器为每个臂单独运行。 联合片段根据 PBDM 的规则被接受，每次尝试包含三次修复和三次去噪步骤。 该自适应方法应用于三到五个臂。

sents.en: This baseline uses independent single-arm priors.
sents.zh: 该基线方法使用独立的单臂先验。

sents.en: During repair, the released partial denoiser runs separately for each arm.
sents.zh: 在修复过程中，释放的部分去噪器为每个臂单独运行。

sents.en: Joint segments are accepted using PBDM’s rules, with three repair attempts and three denoising steps per attempt.
sents.zh: 联合片段根据 PBDM 的规则被接受，每次尝试包含三次修复和三次去噪步骤。

sents.en: The adaptation is applied to three to five arms.
sents.zh: 该自适应方法应用于三到五个臂。

paragraphs.en: An independent PyBullet mesh checker tests inter-arm, obstacle, table, and non-adjacent self collisions. Each trajectory segment has at least eight subdivisions, with joint increments no larger than 0.04 radians. Success requires no detected collisions and finite joint angles within joint limits, with no additional inter-arm clearance margin.
paragraphs.zh: 一个独立的 PyBullet 网格检查器用于检测臂间碰撞、与障碍物的碰撞、与桌面的碰撞以及非相邻的自碰撞。 每个轨迹段至少包含八个子分段，关节增量不超过 0.04 弧度。 成功执行要求未检测到任何碰撞，关节角度在关节限制范围内且有限，并且无需额外的臂间间隙余量。

sents.en: An independent PyBullet mesh checker tests inter-arm, obstacle, table, and non-adjacent self collisions.
sents.zh: 一个独立的 PyBullet 网格检查器用于检测臂间碰撞、与障碍物的碰撞、与桌面的碰撞以及非相邻的自碰撞。

sents.en: Each trajectory segment has at least eight subdivisions, with joint increments no larger than 0.04 radians.
sents.zh: 每个轨迹段至少包含八个子分段，关节增量不超过 0.04 弧度。

sents.en: Success requires no detected collisions and finite joint angles within joint limits, with no additional inter-arm clearance margin.
sents.zh: 成功执行要求未检测到任何碰撞，关节角度在关节限制范围内且有限，并且无需额外的臂间间隙余量。

paragraphs.en: Each task generates its n cand n_{\mathrm{cand}} candidates as one batch on a GH200 GPU using warm CUDA graphs. Timing includes scene setup, generation, transfer, checking, and any repair through the final decision. It excludes model and asset loading, graph preparation, diagnostics, logging, and clean-up.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都会使用温热的 CUDA 图，在 GH200 GPU 上将 n 个候选和 n_{\mathrm{cand}} 个候选作为单个批次生成。 计时包括场景设置、生成、传输、检查以及最终决策前的任何修复过程。 它不包括模型和资产加载、图准备、诊断、日志记录以及清理工作。

sents.zh: 每个任务都会使用温热的 CUDA 图，在 GH200 GPU 上将 n 个候选和 n_{\mathrm{cand}} 个候选作为单个批次生成。

sents.zh: 它不包括模型和资产加载、图准备、诊断、日志记录以及清理工作。

paragraphs.en: We coordinate four text-conditioned human motions using a shared control and a frozen single-person prior. People cross a common region towards opposite destinations, requiring collision avoidance and consistent articulated motion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用共享控制器和冻结的单人体先验，协调四种由文本条件驱动的人类动作。 人们穿过一个公共区域前往相反的方向，这需要避免碰撞并保持连贯的关节运动。

sents.en: We coordinate four text-conditioned human motions using a shared control and a frozen single-person prior.
sents.zh: 我们使用共享控制器和冻结的单人体先验，协调四种由文本条件驱动的人类动作。

sents.en: People cross a common region towards opposite destinations, requiring collision avoidance and consistent articulated motion.
sents.zh: 人们穿过一个公共区域前往相反的方向，这需要避免碰撞并保持连贯的关节运动。

paragraphs.en: Each person i ∈ { 1 , … , N } i\in\{1,\ldots,N\} , with N = 4 N=4 , receives a caption c i c_{i} , a planar start s i ∈ ℝ 2 s_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{2} , an initial yaw ψ i \psi_{i} , and a destination g i = − s i g_{i}=-s_{i} . Starts are arranged on a randomly rotated ring with nominal radius 2.147 ​ m 2.147\,\mathrm{m} , radial jitter ± 0.15 ​ m \pm 0.15\,\mathrm{m} , and angular jitter ± 10 ∘ \pm 10^{\circ} . Yaw points towards the destination with an additional ± 10 ∘ \pm 10^{\circ} jitter. Scene conditions remain fixed during generation, and waiting and lateral detours are allowed. A motion contains F = 120 F=120 frames at 20 ​ Hz 20\,\mathrm{Hz} , represented by 263 263 normalised HumanML features per frame.
paragraphs.zh: 每个个体 i ∈ {1, …, N}（其中 N = 4）都会收到一个描述 c_i、一个平面起点 s_i ∈ ℝ²、一个初始偏航角 ψ_i，以及一个目的地 g_i = −s_i。 起点被排列在一个随机旋转的环上，其标称半径为 2.147 m，径向抖动为 ±0.15 m，角度抖动为 ±10°。 偏航角指向目的地，并带有额外的 ±10° 抖动。 场景条件在生成过程中保持固定，允许等待和横向绕行。 一段运动包含 F = 120 帧，采样频率为 20 Hz，每帧由 263 个归一化的 HumanML 特征表示。

paragraphs.en: We suppress the fixed scene dependence of φ \varphi in the notation. Retaining native features is necessary for the rotation, displacement, and contact-consistency costs, which cannot be evaluated from world-space joint positions alone. State variables, noise, and optimisation are restricted to active people and frames; padded coordinates remain zero throughout. For motion-feature tensors, ∥ ⋅ ∥ 2 \|\cdot\|_{2} denotes the Euclidean norm after vectorisation, without averaging over people, frames, or features.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在符号表示中抑制了 φ \varphi 对固定场景的依赖。 保留原始特征对于旋转、位移和接触一致性代价项是必要的，因为这些代价项无法仅通过世界空间中的关节位置进行评估。 状态变量、噪声和优化过程仅限于活跃人物和帧；填充的坐标在整个过程中保持为零。 对于运动特征张量，∥ ⋅ ∥ 2 \|\cdot\|_{2} 表示向量化后的欧几里得范数，且不对人物、帧或特征进行平均。

Each person’s frozen denoiser is conditioned on its own caption, not on the other people or the scene’s starts and goals, with classifier-free guidance scale 2.5 2.5 . This is a separately trained native 50 50 -step model, not a respaced 1,000 1{,}000 -step checkpoint. Sampling retains its cosine schedule, fixed posterior variance, and unclipped clean predictions.
