Training scenes are generated online, with captions drawn from five families: walking, jogging, high-knee marching, forward jumping, and crouched walking. Each family has three phrasings. paragraphs.en: The deterministic final transition remains in adjoint propagation, but contributes neither control energy nor a matching term. Each transition is differentiated using a fresh state variable at the stored value X ℓ X_{\ell} , with θ ¯ \bar{\theta} fixed and the next-state adjoint detached. The controller’s clean-motion, world-joint, text, and geometry-derived observations are detached and held fixed during this state differentiation, while its explicit noisy-state input and the frozen-prior mean remain differentiable. The recursion follows these observation-detach conventions, rather than differentiating through the recomputation of every controller observation; graphs are released between transitions.
paragraphs.zh: 确定性最终转移在伴随传播中仍然存在，但既不提供控制能量，也不产生匹配项。 每个转移都使用存储值 X ℓ X_{\ell} 处的新状态变量进行微分，其中 θ ¯ \bar{\theta} 被固定，且下一状态的伴随变量被解耦。 在此状态微分过程中，控制器从干净运动、世界关节、文本和几何信息中获得的观测值均被解耦并固定不变，而显式的噪声状态输入和冻结的先验均值仍保持可微分性。 该递归遵循上述观测解耦的惯例，而非对每个控制器观测值的重新计算进行微分；各转移之间的图结构会被释放。

paragraphs.en: The PCD baseline combines eq. 145 with a root-goal projector enforcing the final-window destination condition. The projector changes planar root increments and the corresponding stored joint-displacement channels while keeping headings, heights, and poses fixed. It minimises normalised-feature change within this restricted parameterisation, but does not enforce collision clearance or the kinematic-validity audit. PCD++ uses the same guidance update and replaces that projector with a joint optimisation of the proposed state. All 263 263 normalised feature channels of each active person and frame are free variables in this solve. Feasibility is checked on a freshly recomputed clean estimate at the candidate’s next noise level, rather than on the clean estimate used for the preceding guidance update. At the final transition, the candidate is already a clean motion and 𝒟 K = Id \mathcal{D}_{K}=\mathrm{Id} .
paragraphs.zh: PCD 基线方法将方程 145 与一个根目标投影器相结合，后者用于强制执行最终窗口的目的地条件。 该投影器会改变平面的根增量以及相应的存储关节位移通道，同时保持航向、高度和姿态不变。 它在此受约束的参数化框架内最小化归一化特征的变化，但并未强制执行碰撞间隙或运动学有效性校验。 PCD++ 使用相同的引导更新机制，并将该投影器替换为对所提议状态的联合优化。 每个活跃人物和每一帧中全部 263 个归一化特征通道都是此求解过程中的自由变量。 可行性检查基于候选者下一噪声水平上重新计算得到的干净估计值，而非用于先前引导更新的干净估计值。 在最终转换时，该候选者已经是一个干净的运动，且 𝒟 K = Id \mathcal{D}_{K}=\mathrm{Id}。

paragraphs.en: PCD++ permits at most M = 100 M=100 inner Adam updates per outer transition, with step size η p = 0.01 \eta_{\mathrm{p}}=0.01 , initial penalty ρ 0 = 10 \rho_{0}=10 , and cap ρ max = 10 7 \rho_{\max}=10^{7} . Adam uses ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.999) , ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} , and zero weight decay, with fresh optimiser state at every outer transition. Every five inner updates, the penalty is multiplied by 10 10 , up to its cap, if the maximum violation has not decreased by more than 5 % 5\% since the previous reference check. The solver checks all 15 × 15 15\times 15 capsule pairs for each pair of people at the 596 596 dense times, and checks goals in each person’s final five native frames. It accepts the first verified feasible iterate, with at most M M updates and M + 1 M+1 checks per transition. The accepted state is Z ( m ) Z^{(m)} , not its denoised estimate, so it remains at the correct noise level for the next DDPM transition. Non-finite states, objectives, residuals, or gradients terminate the affected assembly with failure. Failure to find a feasible iterate within the budget also terminates that assembly, without an infeasible fallback. Failed assemblies count as failures in all binary success metrics.
paragraphs.zh: PCD++ 在每个外层转换中最多允许 M = 100 次内部 Adam 更新，其中步长 η p = 0.01，初始惩罚项 ρ 0 = 10，上限为 ρ max = 10 7。 Adam 使用 ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.999 )，ϵ = 10 − 8，且无权重衰减，每次外层转换时都会初始化优化器状态。 每经过五次内部更新，若自上次参考检查以来最大违规程度未下降超过 5%，则惩罚项将乘以 10，直至达到其上限。 求解器在 596 个密集时间点为每对人物检查所有 15 × 15 个胶囊对，并检查每个人最后五个原生帧中的目标。 它接受第一个经过验证的可行迭代点，每次转换最多进行 M 次更新和 M + 1 次检查。 被接受的状态是 Z ( m )，而非其去噪后的估计值，因此在下一次 DDPM 转换时仍能保持正确的噪声水平。 非有限状态、目标函数、残差或梯度将导致受影响的组装过程以失败告终。 若未能在预算内找到可行迭代点，该组装过程也将终止，且不会采用不可行的替代方案。 失败的组装过程在所有二元成功指标中均计为失败。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 2 gives the complete procedure. Each completed outer transition uses one guidance backward pass and at most M M inner-optimisation backward passes, giving at most K ⁡ ( 1 + M ) = 5050 K(1+M)=5050 backward passes per assembly under the reported settings. Early acceptance or failure reduces this count; feasibility checks additionally require forward computations. This counts joint backward evaluations, not separate passes for each person; at the final transition, inner gradients pass through the decoder but not through a denoiser, since 𝒟 K = Id \mathcal{D}_{K}=\mathrm{Id} . The solver does not certify convergence or global distance optimality. Feasibility covers only the stated goal constraints and capsule proxy at checked times, not continuous-time clearance or the complete kinematic-validity audit.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 2 给出了完整的流程。 每次完成的外部转换会使用一次引导反向传播和最多 M 次内部优化反向传播，因此在所报告的设置下，每次组装最多需要 K(1+M)=5050 次反向传播。 提前接受或失败会减少这一次数；可行性检查还需要额外的前向计算。 此计数包括联合反向评估，而非为每个人单独进行的传播；在最终转换时，内部梯度会通过解码器，但不会通过去噪器，因为 𝒟 K = Id \mathcal{D}_{K}=\mathrm{Id}。 该求解器不验证收敛性或全局距离最优性。 可行性仅涵盖在检查时刻所声明的目标约束和胶囊代理，而不包括连续时间内的间隙或完整的运动学有效性审计。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation uses 24 24 fixed scenes drawn from three training action families: walking, jogging, and crouched walking. Thirteen scenes are homogeneous and eleven mix families. Every method is evaluated with five sampling seeds, giving 120 120 attempts per method. These seeds measure sampling variability for one controller, not training variability or held-out layout generalisation. Main figures compare uncontrolled MDM, PCD++, and CMDS ; the appendix comparison also includes Best-of-256, DPS, and PCD. Matched views use the same sampling seed, identical scene conditions, and a common camera. Capsule poses and footpaths show body clearance and goal progress, with faint intermediate poses and emphasised starts and endpoints. Uncontrolled MDM supplies the visual prior reference; table 15 aggregates the full evaluation. Figure 22 extends the qualitative comparison to all evaluated baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 评估使用了从三个训练动作家族（行走、慢跑和蹲行）中选取的 24 个固定场景。 其中 13 个场景是均质的，另外 11 个则混合了不同动作家族。 每种方法都使用五个采样种子进行评估，因此每种方法共有 120 次尝试。 这些种子用于衡量单个控制器的采样变异性，而非训练变异性或对保留布局的泛化能力。 主要图表比较了无控制的 MDM、PCD++ 和 CMDS；附录中的比较还包含了 Best-of-256、DPS 和 PCD。 匹配视图使用了相同的采样种子、完全一致的场景条件以及同一台相机。 胶囊姿态和路径展示了身体与障碍物的间距以及目标进展，同时用淡色显示了中间姿态，并突出了起点和终点。 无控制的 MDM 提供了视觉先验参考；表 15 汇总了完整的评估结果。 图 22 将定性比较扩展到了所有被评估的基线方法。
